jobs.title: Human Resource Consultant 80 – 100% (Zurich)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a team-oriented Human Resource Consultant (f/m/d) to strengthen our consulting services we provide to our organization.

The HR Consulting Team is embedded in the HR organization, collaborating closely with various HR stakeholders such as HR Business Partners, Recruiting-, HR Support Specialists and other HR competence centers in the day-to-day business.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Responsible for delivering comprehensive HR consulting to line management and employees across a diverse workforce in Zurich

• Consulting, coaching and supporting line managers in performing their managerial and leadership function and the employees along the whole employee life cycle

• Fostering strong partnership with the business at all levels of the organisation, regular exchange with line management on HR key topics

• Handling of complex employee relation cases in close collaboration with our HR Legal department and other internal and external stakeholders

• Support recruiting through preparing search, selecting- and interviewing candidates, managing negotiations and onboarding employees

• Supporting HR Business Partners in implementing HR core processes such as Compensation-, Performance Review, Talent Management, reorganisations, etc. in close collaboration with other HR competence center (HR Support, Strategic Recruiting, Pension Fund, Payroll, Compensation)

• Redundancy and exit management: Supporting line managers and employees in all kinds of exit scenarios (resignations, low performer management, behavior related terminations, restructuring measurements based on social plan, termination agreements)

• Maintaining our core HR system “HR Connect” (Workday) and continuously develop own expertise in handling it

• Actively participating in HR projects

YOUR PROFILE

• Relevant educational and professional background, ideally in HR (e.g. Advanced Diploma in HR Management or Certificates in Advanced Studies in Human Capital Management)

• Several years of professional experience in a similar role (min. +5 years), preferably in financial sector

• Skilled and practiced in advising, coaching and recruiting

• Confident in dealing with senior-, line managers and employees of different personalities in an international environment

• Ability to build an internal network based on credibility and trust, integrity and discretion are essential

• Ability to react and adapt to a constantly changing and demanding environment and to deal with different cultures and backgrounds

• Natural team player, empathic and resilient personality, charisma, power of persuasion and good judgement skills

• In-depth knowledge in Swiss employment law

• Sophisticated verbal and written communication and presentation skills in English

• Proficient user of relevant IT systems (MS Office, Workday)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: AI Workshop Facilitator for baer.ai lab max. 10% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start for two years, possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The coach will facilitate interactive, in-person AI workshops for multidisciplinary teams, guide participants through ideation and prototyping, and provide hands-on support with generative AI, data-analysis workflows and automation concepts. Workshop materials, prompts and session outlines will be provided in advance.

Max. 10% employment level; ad hoc based on workshop schedule and mutual availability.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Facilitate small groups during interactive AI workshops and enable hands-on, experiential learning

• Guide participants through brainstorming, solution design and prototyping using accessible AI techniques

• Support exercises involving generative AI tools, data-analysis workflows and automation concepts

• Present clearly and professionally to mixed-tenure audiences, including senior management

• Review the materials, prompts and session outline provided ahead of each session and attend onboarding before the first workshop

• Occasional support with additional tasks in the field of AI, such as the creation of blueprints for tools and documentation

YOUR PROFILE

• Currently completing a degree at a university in a technical field

• Academic background in AI, computer science, data science or a related field

• Solid understanding of core AI and machine-learning concepts

• Familiarity with generative AI tools and practical data workflows

• First experience facilitating hands-on learning and responding dynamically to participant questions

• Ability to understand and explain practical AI concepts and workflows clearly

• Approachable and enthusiastic about collaborative learning

• Clear, confident and professional communication

• Strong facilitation and interpersonal skills

• Adaptability and ability to respond dynamically to questions

• Reliability and preparation for agreed workshop dates

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Client Documentation Generalist 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In this role you will be ensuring accuracy and completeness of account documentation and client data for account opening as well as lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Review documents of individual end legal entities for completeness and accuracy according to CDB 20 and internal directives/guidelines

• Review FATCA and CDB formalities for consistency with CRS/AEI formalities

• Control and approve captured customer data and account documents

• Capture deficiencies detected

• Request missing documents and information to the front

• Support the front regions in questions related to customer documentation and data

• Cooperate with relevant stakeholders (Tax, Legal, Compliance) to continuously streamline and improve processes and procedures

YOUR PROFILE

• Very organized, structured and accurate way of working

• Committed, responsible and resilient personality

• Customer oriented attitude and capability to work under pressure without losing focus

• High level of discretion and trustworthiness

• Networked thinking and quick comprehension skills

• Good knowledge of the Code of Conduct for Banks (CDB20)

• Knowledge of FATCA/QI/CRS

• At least 3 years of professional experience in the field of bank customer documentation

• Completed commercial apprenticeship (banking apprenticeship an advantage) or equivalent training

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Workday Expert 80-100% (f/m/d) maternity cover - until 31.07.2027
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The HR Business Technology team takes on the responsibility of maintaining and developing a state-of-the-art HR technology landscape and delivering employee data to HR and other bank applications. This entails a close partnership with stakeholders across the bank in supporting them to keep employee records at the highest quality and accuracy.

YOUR CHALLENGE
As Senior Technical Workday Expert, you will be:

• Acting as a subject matter expert (SME) in our Workday HCM system with a broad, cross-functional perspective

• Supporting and consulting business SMEs in all questions related to the functional area of your SME role

• Taking ownership for the technical stability, configuration and further development of the Workday tenant

• Developing and continuously improving our Workday system along business and regulatory needs

YOUR PROFILE

• Relevant educational background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems or similar

• Profound knowledge in various modules in Workday HCM preferably in Core HCM, Recruiting and/or Security

• Proven experience in coordinating HR technology initiatives, including stakeholder management, planning, risk and issue handling

• Several years of proven hands-on experience in the configuration of Workday HCM

• Any Workday Pro certification would be an asset

• Ability to quickly understand existing system setups and take over ongoing responsibilities

• Solution-oriented mindset

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking

• Flexible and resilient team player who likes to learn and develop in a continuously changing environment

• Ability to select, evaluate and interpret relevant information

• Intercultural competence to collaborate with a global group of stakeholders

• Client-oriented, independent, and accurate working style

• Sound risk and quality awareness; trustworthy and discreet personality

• Proficient user of Microsoft Office tools

• Proficient in English

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Client Relationship Management 80-100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start for 12 months, possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In this role you will support the GPS Platform Transformation programme, focusing on Client Relationship Management (CRM) capabilities across Sales and Trading. The role will bridge business and technology teams to improve client data management, CRM processes and system integrations, ensuring high-quality and scalable client data solutions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document requirements, translating business needs into technology solutions

• Analyse, structure and model client, contact, legal entity and relationship data to support CRM and Sales processes

• Define business data requirements, data ownership and quality controls for client and relationship information

• Perform data mapping and source-to-target analysis across CRM platforms and related front-office systems

• Improve the accuracy, consistency and usability of client data, client hierarchies and business partner relationships

• Produce business requirements, user stories, process flows and functional specifications

• Collaborate with architects and developers to deliver CRM enhancements, integrations and data solutions

• Support testing, implementation and adoption of CRM capabilities

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance or a related discipline

• 7+ years of business analysis experience within banking or financial services

• Strong experience with CRM platforms and client relationship management processes

• Proven experience in client data management, data modelling and relationship modelling

• Hands-on experience with data mapping, source-to-target mapping and data migration activities

• Understanding of Customer Master Data / Golden Source concepts, data governance and data quality frameworks

• Experience with business partner structures, client hierarchies and legal entity data

• Experience integrating CRM platforms with upstream and downstream systems via APIs and interfaces

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications

• Knowledge of Client Onboarding, Sales, Client Coverage or Wealth Management processes is advantageous

• Communicates clearly across functions and cultures, influences decisions without formal authority, and navigates complex organisations to drive outcomes

• Quickly troubleshoots issues, applies sound judgement in controlled environments, and remains focused on delivery despite ambiguity or changing priorities

• Works independently and proactively in global teams, contributes to collaborative Agile ways of working, and maintains a team-first mindset to achieve shared goals

• Fluency in English; German is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer - Governance & Policies 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Governance & Policies team within the Central Compliance Department based in Zurich, we are looking for a Compliance Officer to join the team. Our team acts as central hub for policies and standards and is responsible for maintaining a robust Compliance Risk Framework which is essential for upholding regulatory request, promoting effective governance and ensuring highest  standards of compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Handle third-party due diligence requests incl. the development and implementation of solutions to support continuous improvement of related processes and procedures

• Support Risk Type Owners in Compliance with the implementation of regulatory developments and industry best practices into internal policies and standards

• Support the enhancement and implementation of global Compliance standards

• Participate in key initiatives to set up new methodologies & standards

• Maintenance of the Compliance Risk Management Framework incl. coordination of the Global Compliance Program and regulatory and/or external audits

• Opportunity to interact with senior stakeholders within Compliance and Business and as well as with the Group’s international locations

• Collaborate with partners across all three Lines of Defence and domestic and foreign Group affiliates

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in law, compliance, banking & finance, business administration)

• Minimum 3 years of banking industry experience with a focus on conceptional work in a compliance, risk management, legal or audit function in the area of Private Banking. Experience with Policies and Governance is a plus

• Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills in approaching tasks, team-player, proactive attitude, in addition to attention to detail

• Stress-resistant, ability to cope with tight deadlines and deliver independently under time pressure

• Good communication skills, ability to build and maintain sound relationship with stakeholders

• Fluent in written and spoken English, other languages are an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Per il nostro team di Governance & Policy all'interno del Central Compliance Department con sede a Zurigo, stiamo cercando un Compliance Officer per unirsi alla squadra. Il nostro team funge da hub centrale per le politiche e gli standard ed è responsabile del mantenimento di un robusto Quadro di Rischio di Compliance che è essenziale per sostenere la richiesta di regolamentazione, promuovere una governance efficace e garantire elevati standard di conformità nelle nostre operazioni.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Gestire richieste di due diligence di terze parti incl. lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di soluzioni per supportare il miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle procedure correlati

• Support Risk Type Proprietari in conformità con l'implementazione di sviluppi normativi e best practice del settore in politiche e standard interni

• Sostenere il miglioramento e l'attuazione degli standard globali di conformità

• Partecipare a iniziative chiave per creare nuove metodologie e standard

• Manutenzione del Quadro di Gestione del Rischio di Compliance incl. coordinamento del Programma di Compliance Globale e audit normativi e/o esterni

• Opportunità di interagire con gli stakeholder senior all’interno di Compliance e Business e con le sedi internazionali del Gruppo

• Collabora con partner in tutte e tre le Linee di Difesa e consociate di Gruppo nazionali ed esteri

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea o equivalente (preferibilmente in diritto, conformità, banca e finanza, amministrazione aziendale)

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nel settore bancario con un focus sul lavoro concettuale in una funzione di conformità, gestione dei rischi, legale o audit nell'area di Private Banking. L'esperienza con le politiche e la governance è un plus

• Forte capacità analitiche, concettuali e di problem solving nell'avvicinarsi a compiti, team-player, atteggiamento proattivo, oltre ad attenzione ai dettagli

• Stress-resistente, capacità di far fronte a scadenze strette e fornire indipendentemente sotto pressione del tempo

• Buone capacità di comunicazione, capacità di costruire e mantenere il rapporto sonoro con gli stakeholder

• Fluente in inglese scritto e parlato, altre lingue sono un vantaggio

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.
Non è questo che stai cercando? Impostare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Für unser Governance & Policies-Team in der Central Compliance-Abteilung mit Sitz in Zürich suchen wir einen Compliance Officer, der sich dem Team anschließt. Unser Team fungiert als zentrale Drehscheibe für Richtlinien und Standards und ist für die Aufrechterhaltung eines robusten Compliance-Risiko-Rahmens verantwortlich, der für die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen, die Förderung einer effektiven Governance und die Gewährleistung höchster Compliance-Standards in unseren Betrieben unerlässlich ist.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Bearbeitung von Due-Diligence-Anfragen von Drittanbietern inkl. Entwicklung und Implementierung von Lösungen zur Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der damit verbundenen Prozesse und Verfahren

• Unterstützung von Risikotyp-Eigentümern bei der Umsetzung von regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Best Practices in interne Richtlinien und Standards

• Unterstützung der Verbesserung und Umsetzung globaler Compliance-Standards

• Teilnahme an wichtigen Initiativen zur Einrichtung neuer Methoden und Standards

• Pflege des Compliance Risk Management Frameworks inkl. Koordination des Global Compliance Programms und regulatorischer und/oder externer Audits

• Gelegenheit zur Interaktion mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern innerhalb von Compliance und Business sowie mit den internationalen Standorten der Gruppe

• Soutien Type de risque Propriétaires en conformité avec la mise en oeuvre de la réglementation et des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie dans les politiques et les normes internes

• Appuyer le renforcement et la mise en œuvre des normes mondiales de conformité

• Participer à des initiatives clés pour mettre en place de nouvelles méthodologies et normes

• Maintien du cadre de gestion des risques liés à la conformité, y compris la coordination du Programme mondial de conformité et des vérifications réglementaires ou externes

• Possibilité d'interagir avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau au sein de Conformité et d'Entreprise et avec les sites internationaux du Groupe

• Collaborer avec des partenaires des trois secteurs de la défense et des groupes nationaux et étrangers

• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent (de préférence en droit, conformité, banque et finance, administration des affaires)

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le secteur bancaire avec un accent sur le travail de conception dans une fonction de conformité, de gestion des risques, juridique ou d'audit dans le domaine de la banque privée. Expérience des politiques et de la gouvernance

• Fortes compétences analytiques, conceptuelles et de résolution de problèmes dans l'approche des tâches, le jeu d'équipe, l'attitude proactive, en plus de l'attention aux détails

• Résistant au stress, capacité à respecter des délais serrés et à livrer de façon indépendante sous pression temporelle

• Bonnes compétences en communication, capacité à établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les intervenants

• Fluent en anglais écrit et parlé, les autres langues sont un avantage

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.
We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager who is passionate about driving finance related projects and create impact on profitability, performance and cost management topics for Julius Baer’s private banking business in Western Markets & Switzerland.
You will be joining a dynamic and experienced team of Finance experts who act as sparring partners to the regional senior management, supporting them in achieving their objectives and anticipating trends in the financial performance at an early stage.
In this challenging and exciting role, you will be part of the CFO Western Markets & Switzerland team, and report to the Head of Performance Management, Business Partnering & Initiatives

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Drive & perform in-depth quantitative analyses (using Management Information System) to identify Front Office trends & insights at an early stage with respect to P&L impact and the use of Balance Sheet products and define actionable measures to drive & improve respective performance

• Lead & coordinate initiatives that trigger improvement of front office P&L performance – incl. conceptualization, implementation and rollout with reporting & progress tracking (e.g. revenue / profitability initiatives etc.), for the biggest Region within the Bank’s global business

• Prepare concise, insightful & visually appealing presentations on various finance topics for management meetings

• Act as a sparring partner to the Front in the context of Finance topics, with direct exposure to senior management and key stakeholders across the bank (e.g. Accounting, Treasury, Capital Management, Credit)

• Run business case assessments and market strategy reviews on a regular basis and derive conclusions for decision-making

• Enhance Performance Management and reporting landscape to enable tracking of Julius Baer's long term business strategy execution

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong academic record: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or comparable field of study with above-average grades

• At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable finance or related function within banking / financial industry or in management consulting with focus on banking

• Good knowledge and understanding of the Private Banking business and global financial markets

• Excellent slide writing skills with ability to prepare ‘target audience specific’ communication

• Advanced Excel and data handling skills paired with affinity to derive in-depth quantitative analyses

• Further knowledge of data analytics & visualization applications (e.g. Tableau) are an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multiple senior stakeholders

• Strong analytical, conceptual skills, fast thinker and outstanding team player

• Capital / balance sheet management knowledge (incl. implications of interest rate development) is a plus

• Strong personal drive with good organizational and multi-tasking skills as well as ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

• Highly motivated, independent, pro-active and meticulous work method with a results-oriented mindset and problem-solving attitude

• Fluent in German & English (spoken and written), other languages are an advantage

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.
Siamo alla ricerca di un Analista Finanziario altamente motivato, Performance- & Initiative Manager che è appassionato di progetti relativi alla finanza di guida e creare impatto sulla redditività, sulle prestazioni e sui temi di gestione dei costi per l’attività bancaria privata di Julius Baer nei mercati occidentali e in Svizzera.
Ti unirai a un team dinamico ed esperto di esperti di finanza che agiscono come partner risparmiatore per la gestione senior regionale, supportandoli nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi e anticipando le tendenze delle prestazioni finanziarie in una fase iniziale.
In questo ruolo stimolante ed emozionante, sarete parte del team CFO Western Markets & Switzerland e riferirete al responsabile della gestione delle prestazioni, Business Partnering & Initiatives

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Drive & esegue analisi quantitative approfondite (utilizzando Management Information System) per identificare le tendenze e le intuizioni di Front Office in una fase iniziale rispetto all'impatto P&L e all'uso dei prodotti Balance Sheet e definire misure attuabili per guidare e migliorare le rispettive prestazioni

• Lead & coordinate iniziative che innescano il miglioramento delle prestazioni P&L di front office – incl. concettualizzazione, implementazione e rollout con reporting & progress tracking (ad esempio entrate / iniziative di redditività ecc), per la più grande Regione all’interno del business globale della Banca

• Preparare presentazioni concise, intuitive e visivamente accattivanti su vari argomenti di finanza per riunioni di gestione

• Agire come partner sparring al fronte nel contesto di argomenti di finanza, con esposizione diretta a senior management e stakeholder chiave in tutta la banca (ad esempio contabilità, tesoreria, gestione del capitale, credito)

• Eseguire le valutazioni dei casi aziendali e le recensioni di strategia di mercato regolarmente e trarre conclusioni per il processo decisionale

• Migliorare la gestione delle prestazioni e il paesaggio di reportistica per consentire il tracciamento dell'esecuzione di strategia aziendale a lungo termine di Julius Baer

Il tuo progetto

• Forte record accademico: laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia o campo di studio comparabile con gradi superiori alla media

• Almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza in una finanza comparabile o funzione correlata all'interno del settore bancario / finanziario o in consulenza di gestione con attenzione al settore bancario

• Buona conoscenza e comprensione del business Private Banking e dei mercati finanziari globali

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura dello slide con la capacità di preparare la comunicazione 'target audience specific'

• Avanzate Excel e capacità di gestione dei dati abbinate all'affinità per ricavare approfondite analisi quantitative

• Ulteriori conoscenze sulle applicazioni di analisi e visualizzazione dei dati (ad esempio Tableau) sono un vantaggio

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per collaborare con più stakeholder senior

• Forte capacità analitiche, concettuali, pensiero veloce e giocatore di squadra eccezionale

• La conoscenza della gestione del bilancio (incluse le implicazioni dello sviluppo dei tassi di interesse) è un plus

• Forte unità personale con buone capacità organizzative e multi-tasking così come la capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e soddisfare scadenze strette

• Metodo di lavoro altamente motivato, indipendente, proattivo e meticoloso con una mentalità orientata ai risultati e un atteggiamento di problem solving

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (spoken e scritto), altre lingue sono un vantaggio

• Ammissibilità di lavorare nel paese in cui si applica per la posizione

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste financier hautement motivé, Performance- & Initiative Manager qui est passionné par la conduite de projets liés au financement et crée un impact sur la rentabilité, la performance et les sujets de gestion des coûts pour Julius Baer.
Vous vous joindrez à une équipe dynamique et expérimentée d'experts des finances qui agissent comme partenaires de la haute direction régionale, les aidant à atteindre leurs objectifs et à anticiper les tendances en matière de rendement financier à un stade précoce.
Dans ce rôle stimulant et passionnant, vous ferez partie de l'équipe CFO Western Markets & Switzerland, et relèverez du responsable de la gestion des performances, des partenariats d'affaires et des initiatives

Votre défi

• Diriger et effectuer des analyses quantitatives approfondies (au moyen du système d'information de gestion) afin d'identifier les tendances et les points de vue de l'administration centrale à un stade précoce en ce qui a trait à l'impact des P&L et à l'utilisation des produits du bilan et de définir des mesures réalisables pour stimuler et améliorer les performances respectives.

• Diriger et coordonner les initiatives qui déclenchent l'amélioration de la performance en matière de P&L de l'administration centrale, y compris la conceptualisation, la mise en oeuvre et la mise en oeuvre de rapports et de suivi des progrès (p. ex., les initiatives en matière de revenus et de rentabilité, etc.) pour la plus grande région de la Banque.

• Préparer des présentations concises, perspicaces et visuelles sur divers sujets financiers pour les réunions de gestion

• Agir en tant que partenaire du Front dans le contexte des questions de finances, avec une exposition directe à la haute direction et aux principaux intervenants de la banque (p. ex., comptabilité, trésorerie, gestion du capital, crédit)

• Exécuter régulièrement des évaluations de rentabilité et des examens de la stratégie du marché et en tirer des conclusions pour la prise de décisions

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for safeguarding the bank’s financial integrity by strategically managing assets and liabilities and ensuring the bank's financial health through proactive risk management and strategic financial planning.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide expert analysis and insights on Treasury topics, such as net interest income development, FX impacts, balance sheet dynamics, and credit-related topics to senior management and other key stakeholders

• Lead performance measurement, forecasting, and budgeting activities for the Group Treasury sub-division

• Serve as subject matter expert for initiatives relating to the Treasury P&L and Treasury bond portfolio and investments

• Design and develop analytical tools, reporting frameworks, and dashboards to support decision-making in Treasury relevant areas

• Drive data model development initiatives to enhance Treasury and Credit analytics, including the automation and optimisation of reporting processes

• Ensure end-to-end execution of credit risk reporting, including the production, quality assurance, and dissemination of insights to First- and Second-Line stakeholders, in compliance with regulatory and internal governance requirements

• Lead or support strategic projects and workstreams across Treasury and Credit, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder alignment

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize financial structures, processes, and analytical capabilities, contributing to enhanced financial resilience and strategic growth

• Contribute to a culture of high performance, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team

YOUR PROFILE

• Relevant advanced degree in Finance, Economics, or related field; additional professional certifications such as CFA or CPA are desirable

• Minimum of 4+ years of professional experience in treasury, credit, or a related financial role

• Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to analyse and interpret complex financial data and economic conditions

• Solid understanding of treasury and balance sheet management, counterparty risk, and credit risk management principles

• Proficient in the use of financial software and MS Office, particularly Excel

• Experienced in automating, standardizing, and optimizing financial processes and analytical workflows, leveraging digital tools and data-driven approaches to improve efficiency and transparency

• Ability to work effectively under pressure, managing multiple priorities with keen attention to detail

• Able to prepare and present information in a clear, audience-specific manner; experience with creating intuitive dashboards and proficiency in Tableau considered an advantage

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively manage and build trusted relationships with key stakeholders

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (60% - 80%), Genève, (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Executive Assistant role supporting the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas is a pivotal position requiring an enthusiastic person, showing ownership and a can-do attitude. The Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive, high-calibre administrative and operational support, ensuring seamless day-to-day functioning across priorities.

The successful candidate will support the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas in driving operational efficiency, a complex agenda, travelling arrangement and leadership coordination across the Market.
This individual will serve as a pivotal point of contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

With a proactive mindset and unwavering attention to detail, the Executive Assistant will act as a trusted partner, anticipating needs, managing sensitive information with confidentiality, and contributing to enhanced executive effectiveness.

This role can be well suited for a bachelor/ master student or for a more experienced assistant, willing to work part time.

At Julius Baer, where excellence and client focus define our culture, this role demands the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and service orientation in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Manage the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas calendar proactively: schedule meetings, prioritise appointments, and resolve conflicts

• Organise travel arrangements, including itineraries, visa requirements if applicable, accommodations, and expense reporting

• Serve as gatekeeper by screening calls and emails, handling sensitive correspondence, and ensuring timely follow-up

• Act as liaison between headquarters and the Geneva office, ensuring alignment on policies, communications, and change initiatives

• Seamless alignment with the business management team

• Collaborate with all the key internal stakeholders, including Finance, HR,  Compliance and Legal departments when required, particularly regarding documentation and approvals

• Facilitate internal governance processes: organise regional management committee meetings, track action items, and maintain meeting minutes and follow-ups

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all matters

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, International Relations, or a related field (on going or graduated)

• A first experience in a similar role and affinity with private banking topics

• Ability to travel regularly between Zürich and Geneva and willingness to have daily internal exchanges with the other locations

• Proven ability to work effectively in an executive environment with discretion and professionalism

• Fluency in English and French; Spanish and German language skills are a strong advantage

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Organisational Excellence: Ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail

• Initiative & Problem-Solving: Anticipates needs and proposes solutions without constant supervision

• Communication Skills: Clear, concise, and diplomatic communicator across levels and cultures

• Team Collaboration: Works well both independently and as part of cross-functional teams

• Discretion & Integrity: Handles confidential information with utmost sensitivity and trustworthiness

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager, Geneva, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM) / Group Head(s) (GH) in daily operations, administration and client management. The ARM interacts with internal and external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customised solutions.

Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/GH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, and thus helping the team to manage, develop and grow its client base. They channel client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/GH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/GH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/GH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Conducts reviews, plans, and always documents his/her work

• Supports RM/GH in implementation of projects and initiatives, in close alignment with the Group Business Manager

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/GH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs, GH and Group Business Manager

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• A natural team player

• Ability to relate to colleagues from diverse backgrounds

• Open, approachable and displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Always communicates in a competent and professional manner

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional & Technical Skills

• Appropriate understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

• Good language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

jobs.title: Lead Architect Order Management 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You are a member of the Lead Architects team within the global IT Architecture. Together with your colleagues from the Foundation and System Architecture teams, you are responsible for the future development of the application landscape.
As a Lead Architect for Order Management, you build the bridge to the business and ensure business and IT alignment from a medium to long-term perspective.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As a Lead Architect, you take responsibility for your domain Order Management in the sense of divide & conquer

• You manage the Order Management architecture board and the architectural runway

• You are accountable for architecture decisions within your domain and bring overarching decisions to higher architecture boards

• You ensure that architecture standards are followed within in your domain

• You define target architectures to plan the medium to long-term evolution of your domain on all four architecture layers: Business, Application, Data and Technology

• Your target architectures are harmonised with business stakeholders and cross domains. You ensure that target architectures are both technically and economically feasible.

• You orchestrate system architects for the implementation of the target architectures

• You review architecture artefacts such as Solution Blueprints

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 5 years of experience as a Senior Architect with architecture responsibilities, e.g., Lead / Domain / Enterprise Architect in a larger organisation

• At least 3 years of experience in banking trading / order management

• Strong customer orientation and the ability to enable solutions

• Strong affinity to follow and identify new technology trends and subsequently integrate them into the company

• Convincing business and IT stakeholders with strategic, solution-oriented thinking and diplomatic behaviour

• Master’s degree in engineering, e.g., from ETH or a Technical University

• English: Business fluent. German: Basic

• Understanding of order lifecycle and integration into internal end-to-end processes

• Strategic thinking and the ability to analyse complex topics

• Proven expertise in the design and evaluation of architectural decisions, considering architectural guidelines and economic aspects

• Excellent communication, presentation and consulting skills

• Hands-on experience in software engineering and design of software architectures

• Optional: Hands-on experience with IBM OTMS

• Optional: Certification of TOGAF or SAFe

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Account Manager LATAM, Intermediaries, Geneva, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Account Manager Intermediaries (AM) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration.

The responsibilities include order placement, handling of client requests, execution of trades and providing administrative support to the team.

In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM does not have an own client book. The AM reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM.

He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM.

The AM ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Group Head (GH) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base.

He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports the RMs and the team in client interactions in all respects

• Responds to incoming calls and takes prompt action

• Maintains and updates records of client instructions, details, and preferences

• Creates system-based reports for the RMs

• Provides clients with verbal and/or written information and data, giving neither advice nor any statement of opinion as value judgement

• Handles and executes clients’ requests by processing orders, trades, transactions and, payments (outside e-channels)

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and research with colleagues to improve processes and to increase productivity and quality

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

Risk Management

• Full adherence at all times to compliance, legal guidelines, internal rules, regulations and policies

• Acts as the first line of risk defence, through raising concerns, following up on issues and escalating as necessary

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Sound affinity with Latin America and Switzerland, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Excellent organisational skills, able to work swiftly, independently within the Account Manager’s scope and accurately even when under pressure

• Proactive, friendly, team player and solutions oriented

• Impeccable presentation and communication skills

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Strong integrity, ethics, and risk awareness combined with solid client-focused mindset

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

• Native level in Spanish, and fluency in French and English (oral and written)

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le gestionnaire de comptes intermédiaires (AM) est propriétaire de l'administration du compte, des formalités de documentation et des tâches dans les opérations quotidiennes et les projets ayant une incidence sur l'administration du compte.

Les responsabilités comprennent le placement des commandes, le traitement des demandes des clients, l'exécution des métiers et la fourniture d'un soutien administratif à l'équipe.

Contrairement au gestionnaire de relations (RM), le AM n'a pas de propre carnet de clients. Le MA s'adresse aux clients, le cas échéant, en étroite collaboration avec la RM.

Il/elle fait preuve d'excellentes compétences professionnelles, personnelles et sociales lors de la liaison avec les clients et la RM.

L'AM assure la gestion opérationnelle du compte client et interagit de façon indépendante avec les intervenants internes et externes, fournit aux clients des informations pertinentes et soutient la RM dans la mise en oeuvre de solutions personnalisées. De plus, l'AM sert de modèle pour apporter la meilleure qualité de service aux clients, aux RM et au chef de groupe (GH) de façon rapide, professionnelle et amicale, et ainsi aider l'équipe à gérer et à développer sa clientèle actuelle.

Il transmet les commentaires des clients aux personnes et aux départements concernés de la Banque pour favoriser une amélioration continue et une adaptation rapide des processus. L'AM fait preuve d'un engagement professionnel à assurer une excellente administration du compte, aux clients ainsi qu'à la Banque et est prêt à aller au-delà.

Votre défi
Administration et gestion des clients

• Soutient les RM et l'équipe dans les interactions client à tous égards

• Répondre aux appels entrants et agir rapidement

• Tenir et mettre à jour les dossiers des instructions, des détails et des préférences du client

• Crée des rapports basés sur le système pour les RM

• Fournit aux clients des informations et des données verbales et/ou écrites, ne donnant aucun avis ni aucune déclaration d'opinion comme jugement de valeur

• Traitement et exécution des demandes des clients par le traitement des commandes, des transactions et des paiements (hors canaux électroniques)

Gestion d'entreprise

• Gère les projets internes qui influent sur les relations comptables d'une RM, résolvant directement les problèmes administratifs qui se posent et veillant à ce que tous les systèmes pertinents soient maintenus et mis à jour et à ce que toute la documentation recueillie au besoin

• Collecte et partage des informations, des idées, des conclusions et des recherches pertinentes avec des collègues afin d'améliorer les processus et d'accroître la productivité et la qualité

• Examine, planifie et documente en tout temps son propre travail

• Fournit des propositions d'améliorations professionnelles fondées sur l'expérience, l'événement ou l'observation

Gestion des risques

• Respect intégral en tout temps de la conformité, des directives juridiques, des règles internes, des règlements et des politiques

• Agir comme première ligne de défense des risques, en soulevant des préoccupations, en assurant le suivi des questions et en intensifiant au besoin

VOTRE PROFIL

• Expérience éprouvée dans le service des clients bancaires ayant des besoins complexes (sur l'embarquement de nouveaux clients, le maintien et l'extension des relations actuelles)

• Bonne affinité avec l'Amérique latine ou le Moyen-Orient et la Suisse, c'est-à-dire connaissance de l'environnement juridique et réglementaire ainsi que de la sensibilisation culturelle

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, capables de travailler rapidement, indépendamment dans le cadre du gestionnaire de compte et avec précision même sous pression

• Proactive, amical, team player et des solutions orientées

• Capacités de présentation et de communication impeccables

• Hautement axé sur le service et passionné par le service client

• Forte intégrité, éthique et sensibilisation au risque associée à une solide mentalité axée sur le client

• Connaissance avancée des marchés financiers mondiaux et de l'évolution actuelle de l'industrie

• Forte maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit). Langue supplémentaire, en particulier l'espagnol, un atout

• Bonne EM Compétences de bureau

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and backend services for real-time decisioning, reporting, data collecting, and related functions

• Data Requirements and Modeling

• Data Management and Transformation

• Produce high-quality, well-tested, and secure code

• Develop and maintain software designed to improve data governance and security

• Develop processes designed to ensure Data Security and Data Quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related technical field; or equivalent training and professional experience

• 5+ years of experience in ETL/ELT, data warehousing, Business Intelligence, and integrating data processing/workflow management tools into pipeline design

• 5+ years building and maintaining end-to-end data systems using Python, Scala, or similar programming languages

• Solid experience in utilising SQL for data analysis, investigating data issues, diagnosing root causes, and designing effective solutions

• Experience in working with cloud-based data technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, within continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) environments

• Demonstrated experience working with large-scale datasets using Databricks, PySpark, Spark Streaming, and Delta Lake

• Familiarity with cloud storage solutions such as Azure Data Lake and Blob Storage

• Solid understanding of data modelling principles (experience with Data Vault is a plus) and strong skills in system design, implementation, and testing

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is looking for a forward-thinking Platform Owner to shape the future of Julius Baer`s enterprise technology platform offering. In this pivotal leadership role, you will define and drive the technical vision, roadmap, and operational excellence of the global data platform enabling data-driven decision-making and reporting across the bank.

You will play a central role in transforming how we build, scale, and govern our foundational data infrastructure - balancing innovation with robustness, agility with compliance, and speed with sustainability. Working closely with enterprise architecture, product owners, engineering teams, and external partners, you will ensure that platform capabilities consistently meet evolving business and consumer demands and adhere to stringent IT, risk, and regulatory standards.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Define and maintain the end-to-end technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and lifecycle strategy for the global data platform

• Gathering requirements and maintaining relationships with current and potential consumer base. Ensuring the technical vision and roadmap enables their current and future business ambitions

• Ensure platform scalability, reliability, performance, and security, embedding non-functional requirements (NFRs), observability, automation, and resilience-by-design principles

• Lead the prioritisation and delivery of platform features and capabilities, collaborating with Product Manager, Scrum Masters, Development Teams, System Architect, and Release Train Engineer to coordinate work across Agile teams

• Own the platform backlog, ensuring clear initiatives, features, and user stories. Prioritise the delivery, balancing trade-offs between innovation, tech debt reduction, and operational stability

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for incidents, problems, audits, and risk findings related to the platform

• Establish and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs; leverage metrics and OKRs to measure platform health, usage, team performance, and business value delivered

• Drive standardisation, reuse, and simplification across the platform ecosystem to reduce complexity, improve interoperability, and accelerate time-to-market

• Coach and guide Technical Leads, and development teams, fostering best practices in coding, testing, deployment, and incident response

• Shape the target operating model for platform operations—including staffing, governance, RACI definitions, and handover processes—supporting sustainable growth and efficient run-models

• Represent the platform in executive forums and governance bodies, articulating progress, risks, investments, and strategic decisions to stakeholders across technology and business areas

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology roles within large, regulated enterprises—preferably in financial services

• Proven experience owning, leading or scaling large-scale data platforms – preferably big data technology

• Track record with defining and delivering technical platform visions and roadmaps in enterprise environments

• Hands-on exposure to modern data technologies such as Apache Spark / Iceberg, Trino, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake/Databricks, Hadoop ecosystems, or equivalent

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines

• Track record in managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple technical teams, vendors, and domains—demonstrating influence without direct authority

• Familiarity with risk and compliance frameworks applicable to Swiss financial institutions and experience addressing audit points or IT risk items

• Exceptional technical leadership and systems thinking, able to balance short-term delivery with long-term platform sustainability

• Strong communication skills on all levels. Ability to summarise complex issues for management, while also being able to discuss on a detail level with technical teams

• Expertise in software lifecycle governance, technical debt management, vulnerability remediation, and release approval processes

• Skilled in road-mapping, backlog refinement, dependency management, and translating business capabilities into actionable technical initiatives

• People person or comfortable with significant business / consumer interaction

• Solid understanding of non-functional requirements—performance, availability, recoverability, monitoring, logging, and security-by-default

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data-informed decisions using KPIs, telemetry, and feedback loops

• Fluent in English, both written and verbal; German language skills are a advantage

• Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, multinational environment with competing priorities

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Julius Baer è alla ricerca di un armatore di piattaforme in grado di modellare il futuro dell'offerta di piattaforma enterprise di Julius Baer. In questo ruolo di leadership fondamentale, definirai e guiderai la visione tecnica, la roadmap e l'eccellenza operativa della piattaforma dati globale che consente il processo decisionale e il reporting basati sui dati in tutta la banca.

Si svolgerà un ruolo centrale nella trasformazione di come costruire, scalare e governare la nostra infrastruttura di dati di base - bilanciando l'innovazione con robustezza, agilità con la conformità e la velocità con la sostenibilità. Lavorando a stretto contatto con l'architettura aziendale, i proprietari di prodotti, i team di ingegneria e i partner esterni, vi assicurerete che le funzionalità della piattaforma soddisfino costantemente le esigenze aziendali e dei consumatori in evoluzione e aderiscano a standard IT rigorosi, rischio e normative.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Definire e mantenere la visione tecnica end-to-end, la roadmap pluriennale e la strategia del ciclo di vita per la piattaforma globale dei dati

• Raccogliere i requisiti e mantenere le relazioni con la base di consumo attuale e potenziale. Garantire la visione tecnica e la roadmap consente le loro ambizioni aziendali attuali e future

• Garantire scalabilità, affidabilità, prestazioni e sicurezza della piattaforma, incorporando requisiti non funzionali (NFR), osservanza, automazione e principi di resilienza-by-design

• Guidare la priorità e la consegna di funzionalità e funzionalità della piattaforma, collaborando con Product Manager, Scrum Masters, Development Teams, System Architect e Release Train Engineer per coordinare il lavoro tra i team Agile

• Possedere il backlog della piattaforma, assicurando chiare iniziative, caratteristiche e storie degli utenti. Priorizzare la consegna, bilanciare gli scambi tra innovazione, riduzione del debito tecnico e stabilità operativa

• Servire come punto di escalation tecnico primario per incidenti, problemi, audit e risultati dei rischi legati alla piattaforma

• Stabilire e monitorare SLAs, SLOs e KPI; sfruttare metriche e OKR per misurare la salute della piattaforma, l'utilizzo, le prestazioni del team e il valore aziendale consegnato

• Guida la standardizzazione, il riutilizzo e la semplificazione dell'ecosistema della piattaforma per ridurre la complessità, migliorare l'interoperabilità e accelerare il time-to-market

• Coach e guida i lead tecnici e i team di sviluppo, promuovendo le migliori pratiche nella codifica, test, distribuzione e risposta agli incidenti

• Formare il modello operativo di destinazione per le operazioni di piattaforma, tra cui il personale, la governance, le definizioni RACI e i processi di consegna, sostenendo la crescita sostenibile e efficienti modelli di run-models

• Rappresentare la piattaforma in forum esecutivi e organi di governance, articolando i progressi, i rischi, gli investimenti e le decisioni strategiche per gli stakeholders in tutte le aree tecnologiche e aziendali

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea o master in informatica, sistemi informativi, o un campo correlato

• Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza in ruoli tecnologici all'interno di grandi imprese regolamentate, preferibilmente nei servizi finanziari

• Provata esperienza di possedere, leader o scalare piattaforme di dati su larga scala – preferibilmente grande tecnologia dei dati

• Tracciare il record con la definizione e la fornitura di visioni di piattaforme tecniche e roadmap in ambienti aziendali

• Esposizione manuale alle moderne tecnologie di dati come Apache Spark / Iceberg, Trino, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake/Databricks, ecosistemi Hadoop, o equivalenti

• Forte comprensione delle metodologie Agile, pratiche DevOps, pipeline CI/CD

• Tracciare il record nella gestione di iniziative interfunzionali che coinvolgono più team tecnici, venditori e domini, dimostrando l'influenza senza autorità diretta

• Familiarità con i quadri di rischio e di conformità applicabili alle istituzioni finanziarie svizzere e ai punti di audit o agli elementi di rischio IT

• Eccezionale leadership tecnica e sistemi di pensiero, in grado di bilanciare la consegna a breve termine con la sostenibilità della piattaforma a lungo termine

• Forte capacità di comunicazione su tutti i livelli. Capacità di riassumere questioni complesse per la gestione, pur potendo discutere a livello di dettaglio con i team tecnici

• Competenza nella governance del ciclo di vita del software, gestione del debito tecnico, riparazione delle vulnerabilità e processi di approvazione del rilascio

• Abilitato in road-mapping, backlog raffiment, gestione delle dipendenze e tradurre le capacità aziendali in iniziative tecniche attuabili

• Persone persona o confortevole con un'attività significativa / interazione con i consumatori

• Solida comprensione dei requisiti non funzionali — prestazioni, disponibilità, recuperabilità, monitoraggio, registrazione e sicurezza-by-default

• Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di prendere decisioni informate utilizzando KPI, telemetria e loop di feedback

• Fluente in inglese, sia scritto che verbale; competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio

• Capacità di operare efficacemente in un ambiente multinazionale matrice con priorità concorrenti

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Julius Bär ist auf der Suche nach einem zukunftsweisenden Plattformbesitzer, der die Zukunft des Unternehmenstechnologie-Plattformangebots von Julius Bär gestaltet. In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle definieren und steuern Sie die technische Vision, den Fahrplan und die operative Exzellenz der globalen Datenplattform, die eine datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und Berichterstattung in der gesamten Bank ermöglicht.

Sie werden eine zentrale Rolle dabei spielen, die Art und Weise zu verändern, wie wir unsere grundlegende Dateninfrastruktur aufbauen, skalieren und steuern - Innovation mit Robustheit, Agilität mit Compliance und Geschwindigkeit mit Nachhaltigkeit in Einklang bringen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Unternehmensarchitektur, Produkteigentümern, Engineering-Teams und externen Partnern stellen Sie sicher, dass die Plattformfähigkeiten die sich ändernden Geschäfts- und Verbraucheranforderungen konsequent erfüllen und strenge IT-, Risiko- und Regulierungsstandards einhalten.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Definieren und pflegen Sie die durchgängige technische Vision, die mehrjährige Roadmap und die Lebenszyklusstrategie für die globale Datenplattform

• Sammeln von Anforderungen und Pflege von Beziehungen mit aktuellen und potenziellen Verbraucherbasis. Sicherstellen der technischen Vision und Roadmap ermöglicht ihre aktuellen und zukünftigen Geschäftsambitionen

• Besitzen Sie das Backlog der Plattform und sorgen Sie für klare Initiativen, Funktionen und User Stories. Priorisieren Sie die Lieferung und balancieren Sie Kompromisse zwischen Innovation, technischem Schuldenabbau und operativer Stabilität

• Als primärer technischer Eskalationspunkt für Vorfälle, Probleme, Audits und Risikobefunde im Zusammenhang mit der Plattform

• Standardisierung, Wiederverwendung und Vereinfachung im gesamten Plattform-Ökosystem vorantreiben, um die Komplexität zu reduzieren, die Interoperabilität zu verbessern und die Markteinführungszeit zu beschleunigen

• Assurer l'évolutivité, la fiabilité, les performances et la sécurité de la plate-forme, intégrer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR), l'observation, l'automatisation et les principes de résilience par conception

• Diriger la hiérarchisation et la livraison des fonctionnalités et des capacités de la plate-forme, en collaboration avec Product Manager, Scrum Masters, Development Teams, System Architect et Release Train Engineer pour coordonner le travail entre les équipes Agile

• Détenir l'arriéré de la plateforme, en assurant des initiatives claires, des fonctionnalités et des histoires d'utilisateurs. Privilégier la livraison, équilibrer les compromis entre l'innovation, la réduction de la dette technologique et la stabilité opérationnelle

• Servir de principal point d'escalade technique pour les incidents, les problèmes, les audits et les constatations de risques liés à la plateforme

• Établir et surveiller les SLA, les SLO et les KPI; mettre à profit les mesures et les OKR pour mesurer la santé, l'utilisation, la performance de l'équipe et la valeur opérationnelle de la plateforme

• Favoriser la normalisation, la réutilisation et la simplification de l'écosystème de la plate-forme afin de réduire la complexité, d'améliorer l'interopérabilité et d'accélérer la commercialisation

• Entraîneur et guide Responsables techniques et équipes de perfectionnement, favorisant les pratiques exemplaires en matière de codage, d'essai, de déploiement et d'intervention en cas d'incident

• Concevoir le modèle d'exploitation cible pour les opérations de la plate-forme, y compris la dotation en personnel, la gouvernance, les définitions du RACI et les processus de transfert, soutenir la croissance durable et des modèles d'exécution efficaces

• Représenter la plateforme dans les instances exécutives et les organes de gouvernance, articuler les progrès, les risques, les investissements et les décisions stratégiques aux parties prenantes dans les domaines de la technologie et des affaires

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, systèmes d'information ou domaine connexe

• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans les rôles technologiques au sein des grandes entreprises réglementées, de préférence dans les services financiers

• Expérience éprouvée de posséder, de diriger ou d'étendre des plates-formes de données à grande échelle – de préférence la technologie des mégadonnées

• Track record avec la définition et la prestation de visions et de feuilles de route de la plate-forme technique dans les environnements d'entreprise

• Exposition directe aux technologies modernes de données comme Apache Spark / Iceberg, Trino, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake / Databricks, les écosystèmes Hadoop, ou l'équivalent

• Bonne compréhension des méthodologies agiles, des pratiques DevOps, des pipelines CI/CD

• Suivre la gestion d'initiatives interfonctionnelles impliquant plusieurs équipes techniques, fournisseurs et domaines – démontrer l'influence sans autorité directe

• Connaissance des cadres de risque et de conformité applicables aux institutions financières suisses et expérience des points d'audit ou des éléments de risque informatique

• Leadership technique exceptionnel et réflexion sur les systèmes, en mesure d'équilibrer la prestation à court terme et la durabilité à long terme de la plateforme

• Fortes compétences en communication à tous les niveaux. Capacité de résumer des questions complexes pour la gestion, tout en étant en mesure de discuter de manière détaillée avec les équipes techniques

• Expertise en gouvernance du cycle de vie des logiciels, gestion technique de la dette, assainissement de la vulnérabilité et processus d'approbation des rejets

• Compétence en cartographie des routes, perfectionnement de l'arriéré, gestion de la dépendance et traduction des capacités opérationnelles en initiatives techniques réalisables

• Personnes personnes ou à l'aise avec une interaction importante entre les entreprises et les consommateurs

• Compréhension solide des exigences non fonctionnelles – performance, disponibilité, récupération, surveillance, enregistrement et sécurité par défaut

• Forte capacité d'analyse avec la capacité de prendre des décisions éclairées en utilisant les ICR, la télémétrie et les boucles de rétroaction

• La maîtrise de l'anglais, à la fois écrite et verbale; l'allemand est un avantage

• Capacité d'opérer efficacement dans un environnement multinational matricié avec des priorités concurrentes

• Enjoyment of professional and technical details

Education & Skillset:

• Banking apprenticeship, basic commercial training or high school diploma (preferably with banking experience)

jobs.title: Senior System Architect for GPS ART 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start for 12 months, possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a member of the GPS IT Architecture Center of Excellence, you will act as the System Architect for one of the GPS owned platforms to shape the future functional infrastructure in the GPS division. You will work closely with the Product Managers, Product Owners, IT Application responsible and Agile teams to drive the delivery of the roadmap for the journey ahead of us, to enable further digital services and offerings to our clients.

This senior architect role enables you to closely collaborate with Business owners and various stakeholders to unlock the GPS potential and elaborate and present innovative and efficient solutions up to C-Level. The role calls for a foundation of strong business acumen and knowledge of a global Markets environment, experience with Derivative product issuing, trading and hedging process supported by profound functional and technical architecture expertise.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Drive definition of GPS target and transition architecture for various initiatives, ensuring alignment with the overall enterprise architecture vision and objectives and close collaboration with business stakeholders

• Own solution blueprint definition and transition roadmaps with concrete input for Markets OVS to achieve the target application landscape

• Support the definition and execution of the GPS Architecture governance and ensure your ART is compliant with enterprise architecture standards, policies and guidelines

• You understand the trends and drivers in the financial industry, markets & technology and propose innovative and sound solutions with your business partners

• You empower Agile squads to deliver fit for purpose solutions and support them with any architecture relevant topics

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology (Master's degree preferred)

• Proven multi-year experience as a System Architect within financial industry or consulting with banking focus

• Good understanding of Markets environment, preferably with past responsibility for trading, execution or derivatives issuing architecture and design in previous projects

• Several years of experience implementing or supporting Front Arena and/or Murex in a banking or financial services environment including familiarity with the data models, risk engines, and reporting components of these vendor platforms

• Solid understanding of market and credit risk concepts, including value-at-risk, sensitivities, counterparty exposure, P&L explain etc.

• Experience with various integration technologies (e.g., streaming, messaging, web services)

• Hands-on experience as web software developer (e.g., Java, .Net, Java Script, React, Angular, relational databases, No SQL databases) is a strong advantage

• Knowledge and curiosity in current technologies, technology trends, and financial market developments

• Certification in business architecture (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is highly desirable

• Excellent knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, methodologies, and tools

• Passionate about technology with a “can do” attitude and entrepreneurial spirit in getting things done in a fast-paced environment of continuous change

• Person with strong personal drive to improve status quo, to share knowledge, make team better and open to learn and collaborate with peers and stakeholders

• Good organisational skills, analytical, quantitative and problem-solving mind-set

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present ideas to technical and business stakeholders on the company, domain, and team level
