Come membro del GPS IT Architecture Center of Excellence, si agirà come System Architect per una delle piattaforme di proprietà GPS per modellare la futura infrastruttura funzionale nella divisione GPS. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Product Manager, Product Owners, IT Application responsabile e Agile per guidare la consegna della roadmap per il viaggio avanti a noi, per consentire ulteriori servizi e offerte digitali ai nostri clienti.

Questo ruolo di architetto senior consente di collaborare strettamente con i proprietari di Business e con i vari stakeholder per sbloccare il potenziale GPS e presentare soluzioni innovative ed efficienti fino a C-Level. Il ruolo richiede una base di forte acume aziendale e la conoscenza di un ambiente di mercato globale, l'esperienza con il prodotto derivato emissione, il trading e il processo di copertura sostenuto da profonda esperienza di architettura funzionale e tecnica.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Definizione di destinazione GPS e architettura di transizione per varie iniziative, garantendo l'allineamento con la visione e gli obiettivi dell'architettura aziendale globali e la stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali

• Definizione del proprio modello di soluzione e roadmap di transizione con input concreti per Markets OVS per raggiungere il paesaggio delle applicazioni di destinazione

• Supporta la definizione e l'esecuzione della governance di Architettura GPS e assicura che la tua ART sia conforme agli standard di architettura aziendale, alle politiche e alle linee guida

• Capisci le tendenze e i driver nel settore finanziario, i mercati e la tecnologia e proponi soluzioni innovative e solide con i tuoi partner commerciali

• È possibile che le squadre di Agile forniscano soluzioni adatte e li supportino con qualsiasi architettura argomenti rilevanti

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea in tecnologia dell'informazione (la laurea preferita)

• Provata esperienza pluriennale come System Architect nell'industria finanziaria o consulenza con focus bancario

• Buona comprensione dell'ambiente dei mercati, preferibilmente con la responsabilità passata per il trading, l'esecuzione o i derivati che emettono architettura e design in progetti precedenti

• Esperienza con varie tecnologie di integrazione (ad esempio, streaming, messaggistica, servizi web)

• Hands-on esperienza come sviluppatore di software web (ad esempio, Java, .Net, Java Script, React, Angular, database relazionali, No database SQL) è un vantaggio forte

• Conoscenza e curiosità nelle attuali tecnologie, tendenze tecnologiche e sviluppi del mercato finanziario

• La certificazione in architettura aziendale (ad esempio, TOGAF, BIZBOK) è altamente auspicabile

• Conoscenza eccellente di strutture di architettura aziendale, metodologie e strumenti

• Appassionato di tecnologia con un atteggiamento “può fare” e spirito imprenditoriale nell’ottenere le cose in un ambiente frenetico di continuo cambiamento

• Persona con forte impulso personale per migliorare lo status quo, per condividere le conoscenze, rendere il team migliore e aperto per imparare e collaborare con colleghi e stakeholders

• Buone capacità organizzative, analitiche, quantitative e problem solving

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, tra cui la capacità di presentare idee agli stakeholder tecnici e aziendali a livello aziendale, aziendale, di dominio e di team

Als Mitglied des GPS IT Architecture Center of Excellence fungieren Sie als Systemarchitekt für eine der GPS-eigenen Plattformen, um die zukünftige funktionale Infrastruktur in der GPS-Division zu gestalten. Diese Rolle als leitender Architekt ermöglicht es Ihnen, eng mit Geschäftsinhabern und verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten, um das GPS-Potenzial zu erschließen und innovative und effiziente Lösungen bis C-Level zu entwickeln und zu präsentieren. Die Rolle erfordert eine Grundlage für starken Geschäftssinn und Wissen über ein globales Marktumfeld, Erfahrung mit der Ausgabe von Derivateprodukten, dem Handel und dem Hedging-Prozess, unterstützt durch fundierte funktionale und technische Architekturexpertise.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Die Definition der GPS-Ziel- und Übergangsarchitektur für verschiedene Initiativen vorantreiben, die Ausrichtung auf die allgemeine Vision und Ziele der Unternehmensarchitektur sicherstellen und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Unternehmensbeteiligten sicherstellen

• Unterstützen Sie die Definition und Ausführung der GPS-Architektur-Governance und stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre ART den Standards, Richtlinien und Richtlinien für die Unternehmensarchitektur entspricht

• Sie verstehen die Trends und Treiber in der Finanzbranche, Märkte & Technologie und schlagen innovative und solide Lösungen mit Ihren Geschäftspartnern vor

• Sie befähigen Agile Squads, zweckgerechte Lösungen zu liefern und unterstützen sie bei allen architekturrelevanten Themen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie (Master-Abschluss bevorzugt)

• Nachgewiesene mehrjährige Erfahrung als Systemarchitekt in der Finanzbranche oder Beratung mit Schwerpunkt Banking

• Gutes Verständnis des Marktumfelds, vorzugsweise mit früherer Verantwortung für den Handel, die Ausführung oder Derivate, die Architektur und Design in früheren Projekten ausstellen

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant supports the Team and the Relationship Managers (RMs) with all Intermediaries & FO and end-client requests on trading and operational aspects - with the objective to ensure seamless operations and fast, competent and complete responses. Responsibilities include order placement, handling of client requests, payment execution and placement of loans and deposits. Accuracy and timeliness are paramount, with effective handling of enquiries and data provision, plus escalation to senior colleagues where necessary. The RM relies on the Assistant to help promote and service the e-channels dedicated to the Intermediaries & FO and to process the related requests and enquiries.
The Assistant is involved in the ongoing information exchange with RMs, plus both internal and external stakeholders in course of business with the clients. As such, they are a role model for professional, competent and high-quality client care and the foundation of our successful Front teams.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Adminstration & Management

• Supports the RM and team in client interaction in all respects

• Attends to incoming calls and takes prompt action

• Maintains and updates records of client instructions, details, and preferences. Creates system-based reports for the RM

• Provides clients with verbal and/or written information and data, giving neither advice nor any statement of opinion as value judgement

• Processes orders, trades, transactions, payments placement (outside e-channels) and handles and executes clients’ requests

• Helps to promote the usage and adoption of our dedicated Intermediaries & FO e-channels

• Monitors the maturity list for deposits, loans, trades; takes action where instruction is standard, seeks instructions (from RM or client) if necessary and required

Business Management

• Organises and follows up client meetings, including logistics and document preparation

• Supports the RM in investigations and troubleshooting, maintaining close bank-internal cross-team/unit collaboration

Risk Management

• Full adherence at all times to compliance, legal guidelines, internal rules, regulations and policies

• Is a first line of risk defence, through raising concerns, following up on issues and escalating as necessary

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent organisational skills, able to work swiftly, independently within the Assistant RM scope and accurately even when under pressure

• Proactive, friendly and solution- as well as customer-oriented attitude

• Strong team player with excellent communication skills

• Professional appearance and impactful

• High personal integrity and risk awareness/ethical mindset

Professional

• Foundational knowledge of financial markets: structure, function and legal/regulatory environment as well as industry awareness

• Basic understanding of relevant products and services applicable to EAM clients, plus valuation principles

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in Italian and English. German is an asset

• Very good MS Office skills

Education & Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

L'Assistente supporta il Team e i Relationship Manager (RM) con tutte le richieste di Intermediari & FO e finali sugli aspetti di trading e operativi - con l'obiettivo di garantire operazioni senza soluzione di continuità e risposte rapide, competenti e complete. Le responsabilità includono il posizionamento degli ordini, la gestione delle richieste dei clienti, l'esecuzione dei pagamenti e il posizionamento dei prestiti e dei depositi. L'accuratezza e la tempestività sono fondamentali, con una gestione efficace delle richieste e dell'erogazione dei dati, più l'escalation a colleghi senior, se necessario. Il RM si affida all'Assistente per aiutare a promuovere e servire gli e-channel dedicati agli Intermediari & FO e per elaborare le relative richieste e richieste.
L'Assistente è coinvolto nello scambio di informazioni in corso con RMs, oltre sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni in corso di business con i clienti. In quanto tali, sono un modello di ruolo per l'assistenza clienti professionale, competente e di alta qualità e la fondazione dei nostri team di successo Front.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Amministrazione e gestione del cliente

• Supporta la RM e il team nell'interazione del cliente in tutti gli aspetti

• Partecipa alle chiamate in arrivo e prende azione rapida

• Mantiene e aggiorna i record di istruzioni, dettagli e preferenze del cliente. Crea report basati sul sistema per la RM

• Fornisce ai clienti informazioni e dati verbali e/o scritti, senza dare né consigli né alcuna dichiarazione di opinione come valutazione del valore

• Elabora gli ordini, gli scambi, le transazioni, il posizionamento dei pagamenti (e-channel esterni) e gestisce ed esegue le richieste dei clienti

• Aiuta a promuovere l'utilizzo e l'adozione dei nostri intermediari e canali FO dedicati

• Monitora l'elenco di scadenza per i depositi, i prestiti, i mestieri; agisce quando l'istruzione è standard, cerca istruzioni (da RM o cliente) se necessario e richiesto

Gestione aziendale

• Organizza e segue riunioni dei clienti, compresa la logistica e la preparazione dei documenti

• Supporta il RM nelle indagini e nella risoluzione dei problemi, mantenendo stretta collaborazione tra le banche-interne/unità

Gestione del rischio

• Aderenza completa in ogni momento alla conformità, linee guida legali, regole interne, regolamenti e politiche

• È una prima linea di difesa del rischio, attraverso l'aumento delle preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi e l'escalation come necessario

Il tuo progetto
Abilità personali e sociali

• Eccellenti capacità organizzative, in grado di lavorare rapidamente, indipendentemente all'interno della portata RM Assistente e con precisione anche sotto pressione

• Proattivo, amichevole e soluzione- così come l'atteggiamento orientato al cliente

• Forte giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• Aspetto professionale e impatto

• Alta integrità personale e consapevolezza del rischio / mentalità etica

Professionista

• Conoscenze fondazionali dei mercati finanziari: struttura, funzione e ambiente legale/regolatorio e consapevolezza del settore

• Comprensione di base dei prodotti e dei servizi applicabili ai clienti EAM, oltre ai principi di valutazione

• Competenze linguistiche eccellenti (verbale e scritta) in italiano e inglese. Il tedesco è un bene

• Molto buone competenze di MS Office

Istruzione e esperienza

• Formazione rilevante (apprendistato bancario o equivalente) e background professionale (esperienza lavorativa nell'industria finanziaria)

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Model Validation & Trade Approval team is part of Market & Treasury Risk and is responsible for independent validation, governance, and ongoing performance assessment of valuation models. Moreover, Model Validation & Trade Approval team is responsible to assessing and challenging model uncertainty and valuation risk drivers that contribute to Model Risk valuation adjustments under Prudent Valuation regulations. The candidate will evaluate and examine modelling assumptions, calibration methodologies, and valuation frameworks to ensure robust model governance and prudent valuation practices.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Perform independent validation of pricing and valuation models used cross rates, credit, FX, derivatives, fixed income, and structured products

• Involvement in New Product Approval process, serving as the gatekeeper for model risk, ensuring that pricing models are robust, well-understood, and subject to appropriate controls and oversight, with a thorough assessment of their conceptual soundness, implementation quality and compliance with the internal governance standards before the product is cleared for launch

• Support Additional Valuation Adjustment (AVA) calculations rising from Model Risk by executing model performance monitoring and period reviews

• Collaborate with Front Office Quants, Market Risk, Product Control, Finance to ensure that valuation methodologies remain robust, transparent, and compliant with internal policies and regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• Advances degree (Master or PhD) in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline

• Strong knowledge of financial products and pricing models across multiple asset classes.

• Strong programming knowledge, preferably Python and Java

• Prior experience in model validation, quantitative research or Front Office Quantitative Development with a deep understanding of model risk management

• Knowledge of Additional Valuation Adjustments (AVA) and prudent valuation frameworks is a plus

• A strong aptitude for analytical thinking and problem solving, with the ability to identify material model risks and valuation uncertainty, and formulate well-supported validation conclusions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working effectively with Front Office Quants, Trading, Market Risk, Product Control, Finance while translating complex quantitative concepts into clear and actionable recommendations

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As an IT Infrastructure Solution Architect at Julius Baer, you will translate business and technical requirements into resilient, secure, and innovative IT architectures, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards while driving end-to-end delivery across cross-functional teams. With a strong foundation in infrastructure, security, and solution architecture, you will act as a trusted advisor—bridging business needs with technological excellence in a dynamic, regulated environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Turn ideas into architecture: Translate infrastructure requirements from projects or products into clear, actionable architecture and design documents — the blueprint for successful delivery

• Ensure compliance: Make sure every solution aligns with internal architectural standards and guidelines, ensuring consistency and reliability

• Be the trusted advisor: Act as the first point of contact for projects and ARTs on infrastructure and middleware topics

• Coordinate seamlessly: Oversee the end-to-end flow of infrastructure tasks across teams and departments, keeping everything on track

• Collaborate with suppliers: Understand the technical details of supplier-delivered capabilities and integrate them smoothly into the overall architecture

• Work hand-in-hand: Partner closely with IT infrastructure architects and engineering teams to deliver robust solutions

• Bridge the gap: Connect business units, technical specialists, project managers, application owners, and infrastructure teams — translating needs into practical solutions

• Enable innovation: Support the setup of new technology stacks and help shape future-ready infrastructure environments

YOUR PROFILE

• Architecture & Infrastructure Expertise: Solid experience in IT infrastructure across medium to large-scale projects. Familiar with the main infrastructure layers and experienced in one or more areas such as security, performance, or capacity management

• Structured and proactive: You work independently, with a clear, goal-oriented approach and a strong sense of ownership

• Security & Resilience: Operational resilience, IT security, risk management, and quality assurance are part of your professional mindset

• Future-focused: You stay ahead of emerging technologies and innovation trends that impact IT environments

• Business-aware: You understand business analysis and requirements engineering processes and can bridge technical solutions with business needs

• Automation & Integration: You know how automation, infrastructure operations, modernization, and technology integration fit together to create efficient environments. Strong knowledge of application integration architecture, technologies, patterns, and security architecture

• Solution-driven: You have a strong grasp of solution architecture and are comfortable navigating concepts like service design and software development best practices

• Architect at heart: You have a solid foundation in architecture principles, methodologies, and modeling techniques — and you’re hands-on with industry-standard practices like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD

• Higher education (e.g., University or Fachhochschule) in a relevant field

• 5–10 years of IT architecture experience; financial services experience is an advantage

• Training in IT infrastructure architecture and project management (waterfall and agile)

• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset

• English business fluent (verbal and written); German is an advantage

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a skilled machine learning engineer (ML Eng) to join one of our agile development teams in our ML & AI ART. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable AI solutions within a DevOps environment. You'll contribute across the entire lifecycle - from concept to deployment - and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality digital solutions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning and AI solutions that address complex business challenges.

• Create multi-agent systems and equip AI models with function/tool-calling capabilities

• Design and implement RAG systems to ground AI responses in enterprise data

• Assess and integrate AI models (e.g. LLMs) ensuring optimal performance and reliability

• Optimize agentic workflows and AI agents for production use cases

• Testing and optimizing system prompts and few-shot example to ensure accurate , consistent, and safe AI outputs

• Performance evaluation of machine learning and AI models using appropriate metrics, evaluation sets and techniques, and continuously iterate and improve upon them

• Collaborate with platform teams, data engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders to integrate machine learning solutions into existing systems and processes

• Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure the quality and reliability of machine learning solutions

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively about complex challenges

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization

• Ability to manage personal workloads effectively, to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and deliver high-quality results on schedule

• Continuous learning mindset, with a passion for staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and artificial intelligence

• Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, reliable, and maintainable code

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field

• Strong programming skills in Python with experience in machine learning libraries and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

• Proven experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs)

• Good understanding of AI agents & agentic workflows, LLM orchestration frameworks and reasoning patterns

• Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model selection and evaluation techniques

• Knowledge of statistical and mathematical concepts relevant to machine learning, such as probability, linear algebra, and optimization

• Understanding software development best practices, including version control, testing, and documentation

• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and effectively

• Relevant work experience in machine learning, data science or a related field

Stiamo cercando un ingegnere esperto di machine learning (ML Eng) per unire uno dei nostri team di sviluppo agili nella nostra ML & AI ART. • Valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli di machine learning e AI utilizzando metriche appropriate, set di valutazione e tecniche, e continuamente iterare e migliorare su di loro

• Collabora con team di piattaforma, ingegneri di dati, scienziati di dati e altri stakeholder per integrare soluzioni di machine learning nei sistemi e processi esistenti

• Partecipa a recensioni di codici, test e debugging per garantire la qualità e l'affidabilità delle soluzioni di machine learning

Il tuo progetto

• Forte problem solving e capacità analitiche, con la capacità di pensare criticamente e creativamente su complesse sfide

• Ottima capacitÃ di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacitÃ di lavorare efficacemente con team e stakeholder interfunzionali a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione

• Capacità di gestire efficacemente i carichi di lavoro personali, di priorizzare le attività, gestire le linee temporali e fornire risultati di alta qualità sul programma

• Mindset di apprendimento continuo, con la passione per rimanere aggiornato con gli ultimi progressi nell'apprendimento automatico e nell'intelligenza artificiale

• Attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno nella produzione di codice affidabile, di alta qualità e manutenbile

• Corso di laurea o Master in Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, Matematica, Statistica, o un campo correlato

• Forte capacità di programmazione in Python con esperienza nelle librerie di machine learning e nei framework di deep learning come TensorFlow o PyTorch

• Esperienza comprovata che lavora con modelli di lingua grande (LLMs)

• Buona comprensione degli agenti dell'AI e dei flussi di lavoro agentici, quadri di orchestrazione LLM e schemi di ragionamento

• Esperienza con preelaborazione dei dati, ingegneria delle caratteristiche e tecniche di selezione e valutazione dei modelli

• Conoscenza di concetti statistici e matematici rilevanti per l'apprendimento automatico, come la probabilità, l'algebra lineare e l'ottimizzazione

• Comprendere le migliori pratiche di sviluppo del software, compreso il controllo della versione, il test e la documentazione

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving e debugging, con la capacità di identificare e risolvere i problemi in modo rapido ed efficace

• Esperienza lavorativa rilevante nell'apprendimento automatico, nella scienza dei dati o in un campo relativo

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Infrastructure Control Plane & Workflow Automation 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities - with Crossplane and Kubernetes-native control planes at the core of that strategy.

Join our team as a Platform Engineer and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of Kubernetes-native control planes using Crossplane, building providers and functions in Golang following the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Design and extend self-service infrastructure offerings that let product teams provision and manage their own resources reliably and at scale

• Build and maintain workflow automation on our orchestration platform, including writing and reviewing the underlying business logic in JavaScript and other scripting languages (we're also evaluating and migrating toward a new automation tooling stack, so adaptability here matters)

• Enable and coach product teams on how to build and extend their own automations on top of the platform, through documentation, workshops, and hands-on guidance - supporting our self-service strategy beyond just building the platform itself

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical strategies

• Contribute technical expertise to the team and help shape technical roadmaps and strategic direction for our automation platforms

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the control plane and automation tooling, and recommend improvements

• Stay up to date with the latest trends in cloud-native computing, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve our solutions

• Contribute to technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 3 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework, to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Experience building or extending workflow automation tooling including writing business logic in JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar - deep expertise in any specific vendor tool is not required, as we understand tools change over time

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of software development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling

• Experience with Golang and at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python

• Experience with Git and agile development methodologies

• Understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure (Windows, Linux, networking, virtualisation, cloud) is a big plus

• Proven experience delivering technical projects independently, and collaborating effectively with multiple technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience teaching, coaching, or enabling other teams or engineers to adopt new tools and ways of working (e.g. through workshops, documentation, or pairing), even without formal people-management responsibility

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional private banking services to our clients worldwide. We foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous development, creating opportunities for talented professionals to grow and make a meaningful impact.

To further strengthen our leading Swiss mortgage franchise, we are looking for a proactive and results-driven Operational Excellence Officer to join our newly established COO Real Estate Team. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the future of our national mortgage operations, drive process improvements, and deliver high-quality services across the entire mortgage lifecycle.

Your Role – Driving Efficiency, Quality & Innovation
As a key member of the Real Estate operations unit, you will ensure the smooth and compliant administration of Julius Baer’s Swiss mortgage portfolio from origination to maturity. Combining precision with strategic thinking, you’ll manage critical operational workflows, uphold rigorous control standards, and provide actionable insights that empower informed decision-making across the organisation. You will balance hands-on execution with forward-looking contributions to transformational initiatives — helping us raise the bar in operational resilience, digitisation, and client service excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
End-to-End Mortgage Operations & Lifecycle Management

• Oversee the complete administrative journey of mortgage facilities — from initial booking and amendments to renewal, early repayment, and final settlement.

• Execute transactional activities with accuracy and timeliness, including new loans, modifications, refinancing, and system updates.

• Ensure consistent data integrity across core banking and real estate systems, serving as a trusted source of truth.

• Collaborate closely with Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal, and external partners to guarantee seamless client experiences and operational agility.

Controls, Compliance & Process Integrity

• Conduct daily operational checks, reconciliations, and exception monitoring to safeguard data accuracy and process reliability.

• Support adherence to internal policies and evolving regulatory requirements (including FINMA oversight, SNB initiatives).

• Proactively identify, escalate, and resolve operational risks and pending items to maintain audit readiness.

• Contribute to refining SOPs, control frameworks, and risk mitigation measures.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Transformation

• Act as an operational partner in cross-functional projects focused on automation, digitalisation, and customer journey enhancement.

• Identify inefficiencies and co-design scalable solutions that elevate both productivity and service quality.

• Assist in shaping future-state processes, technology integrations, and change management rollouts.

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed tertiary education — either a university Bachelor’s degree or a commercial qualification (EFZ) with relevant further training

• 3–5 years of solid experience in Swiss mortgage operations or loan administration, ideally within private banking or retail financial institutions

• In-depth knowledge of the Swiss mortgage lifecycle, product types, collateral handling, and related operational workflows

• Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and operational controls — familiarity with regulatory expectations is a distinct advantage

• Strong analytical abilities and a natural interest in process optimisation, whether in daily tasks or large-scale transformations

• Enjoys project-based work; self-motivated to take initiative and see efforts through to successful completion

• Comfortable operating autonomously while building effective relationships across departments and hierarchies

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); proficiency in French or Italian is a significant asset

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); prior experience with core banking platforms or CRM/loan systems is beneficial

A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

A Julius Baer, siamo orgogliosi di fornire servizi bancari privati eccezionali ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Promuoviamo una cultura di eccellenza, innovazione e sviluppo continuo, creando opportunità per professionisti di talento per crescere e fare un impatto significativo.

Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro principale franchising mutuo svizzero, stiamo cercando un responsabile di eccellenza operativa proattivo e guidato dai risultati per unirsi al nostro nuovo COO Real Estate Team. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di modellare il futuro delle nostre operazioni ipotecarie nazionali, migliorare il processo di guida e fornire servizi di alta qualità in tutto il ciclo di vita del mutuo.

Il vostro ruolo – Efficienza di guida, Qualità & innovazione
Come membro chiave dell'unità operativa di Real Estate, vi assicurerete l'amministrazione liscia e conforme del portafoglio mutuo svizzero di Julius Baer dall'origine alla maturità. Combinando la precisione con il pensiero strategico, gestirai flussi di lavoro operativi critici, mantieni rigorosi standard di controllo e fornisci informazioni attuabili che consentano il processo decisionale informato in tutta l'organizzazione. Equilibrete l'esecuzione pratica con i contributi previsionali alle iniziative di trasformazione, aiutandoci ad alzare la barra nella resilienza operativa, nella digitalizzazione e nell'eccellenza del servizio clienti.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Gestione del ciclo di vita

• Controllare il percorso amministrativo completo delle strutture ipotecarie — dalla prenotazione iniziale e modifiche al rinnovo, il rimborso anticipato, e la risoluzione finale.

• Eseguire attività transazionali con precisione e tempestività, inclusi nuovi prestiti, modifiche, rifinanziamento e aggiornamenti di sistema.

• Assicurare l'integrità dei dati coerente attraverso il core banking e sistemi immobiliari, servendo come fonte attendibile di verità.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal e partner esterni per garantire esperienze client senza soluzione di continuità e agilità operativa.

Controlli, conformità e integrità del processo

• Condurre controlli operativi giornalieri, riconciliazione e monitoraggio delle eccezioni per salvaguardare l'accuratezza dei dati e l'affidabilità del processo.

• Sostenere l'adesione alle politiche interne e i requisiti normativi in evoluzione (comprese le iniziative FINMA oversight, SNB).

• Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi operativi e gli elementi in sospeso per mantenere la disponibilità di audit.

• Contribuire a raffinare le SOP, i quadri di controllo e le misure di mitigazione dei rischi.

Iniziative strategiche e trasformazione aziendale

• Agire come partner operativo in progetti multifunzionali focalizzati sull'automazione, la digitalizzazione e il miglioramento del customer journey.

• Identificare inefficienze e soluzioni scalabili co-design che elevano produttività e qualità dei servizi.

• Assistere nella definizione di processi futuri-stato, integrazioni tecnologiche e rollout di gestione dei cambiamenti.

Il tuo progetto

• Completata l'istruzione terziaria — una laurea universitaria o una qualifica commerciale (EFZ) con relativa formazione ulteriore

• 3-5 anni di solida esperienza nelle operazioni ipotecarie svizzere o nell'amministrazione dei prestiti, idealmente all'interno di istituti finanziari privati o al dettaglio

• Conoscenza approfondita del ciclo di vita mutuo svizzero, tipi di prodotto, gestione collaterale e relativi flussi di lavoro operativi

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei dati, nel reporting e nei controlli operativi — la familiarità con le aspettative normative è un vantaggio distinto

• Forte capacità analitiche e un interesse naturale per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, sia nei compiti quotidiani che nelle trasformazioni su larga scala

• Gode di lavoro basato sul progetto; automotivato per prendere l'iniziativa e vedere gli sforzi attraverso il completamento di successo

• Confortevole funzionamento autonomo mentre la costruzione di relazioni efficaci tra dipartimenti e gerarchie

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato); la competenza in francese o italiano è un bene significativo

• Avanzato utente di Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); esperienza precedente con piattaforme di core banking o sistemi CRM/loan è vantaggioso

Chez Julius Baer, nous sommes fiers de fournir des services bancaires privés exceptionnels à nos clients dans le monde entier. Nous favorisons une culture d'excellence, d'innovation et de développement continu, créant des occasions pour les professionnels talentueux de croître et d'avoir un impact significatif.

Pour renforcer encore notre franchise hypothécaire suisse, nous cherchons un agent d'excellence opérationnelle proactif et axé sur les résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe immobilière COO nouvellement créée. Ce rôle central offre l'occasion de façonner l'avenir de nos opérations hypothécaires nationales, d'améliorer les processus et de fournir des services de haute qualité tout au long du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires.

Votre rôle – Diriger l'efficacité, la qualité et l'innovation
En tant que membre clé de l'unité d'opérations immobilières, vous assurerez la bonne administration et la conformité du portefeuille hypothécaire suisse Julius Baer. Combinant précision et pensée stratégique, vous gérerez les flux de travail opérationnels critiques, respecterez des normes de contrôle rigoureuses et fournirez des informations pratiques qui permettent une prise de décision éclairée dans toute l'organisation. Vous équilibrerez l'exécution pratique avec des contributions tournées vers l'avenir à des initiatives de transformation, nous aidant à relever la barre dans la résilience opérationnelle, la numérisation et l'excellence du service à la clientèle.

Votre défi
Opérations hypothécaires de bout en bout et gestion du cycle de vie

• Surveiller le parcours administratif complet des établissements hypothécaires — de la réservation initiale et des modifications au renouvellement, remboursement anticipé et règlement final.

• Exécuter les activités transactionnelles avec exactitude et rapidité, y compris les nouveaux prêts, les modifications, le refinancement et les mises à jour du système.

• Assurer l'intégrité des données dans les systèmes bancaires et immobiliers de base, en servant de source de vérité fiable.

• Collaborez étroitement avec les partenaires du Front Office, des Services de conseils en hypothèques, du risque de crédit, du secteur juridique et de l'extérieur afin de garantir une expérience client transparente et une agilité opérationnelle.

Contrôles, conformité et intégrité des processus

• Effectuer des vérifications opérationnelles quotidiennes, des rapprochements et une surveillance des exceptions afin de préserver l'exactitude des données et la fiabilité des processus.

• Appuyer le respect des politiques internes et l'évolution des exigences réglementaires (y compris la surveillance de la FINMA, les initiatives de la BNS).

• Déterminer, intensifier et résoudre les risques opérationnels et les éléments en attente afin de maintenir la capacité de vérification.

• Contribuer à raffiner les PNE, les cadres de contrôle et les mesures d'atténuation des risques.

Initiatives stratégiques et transformation opérationnelle

• Agir en tant que partenaire opérationnel dans les projets interfonctionnels axés sur l'automatisation, la numérisation et l'amélioration du parcours client.

• Identifier les inefficacités et co-concevoir des solutions évolutives qui augmentent la productivité et la qualité du service.

• Aider à façonner les processus futurs, les intégrations technologiques et les déploiements de gestion du changement.

• Connaissance approfondie du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires suisses, des types de produits, du traitement des garanties et des flux de travail opérationnels connexes

• Expérience démontrée en matière de gestion des données, de rapports et de contrôles opérationnels — la connaissance des attentes réglementaires constitue un avantage distinct

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et un intérêt naturel pour l'optimisation des processus, que ce soit dans les tâches quotidiennes ou les transformations à grande échelle

• Apprécie le travail basé sur les projets; automotivé pour prendre des initiatives et voir les efforts jusqu'à la réussite

• La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); la maîtrise du français ou de l'italien est un atout important.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Future-proof and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise ​(core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

jobs.title: Account Manager Privat Banking - Nordics Zurich 100%
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM PB does not have an own client book. The AM PB reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM PB ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM PB acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM PB shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences.

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/THs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and researchwith colleagues to improve pro- cesses and to increase productivity and quality

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH proactively.

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English is a must, other languages like German, Finnish and Swedish would be a plus

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB training programme

Oltre al profilo di ruolo di Assistente Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking, il Responsabile del Conto Privato Bancario (AM PB) assume la proprietà dell'amministrazione del conto, delle formalità di documentazione e delle attività nelle operazioni quotidiane e nei progetti che influenzano l'amministrazione del conto. A differenza del Relationship Manager (RM), l'AM PB non dispone di un proprio libro clienti. L'AM PB si rivolge ai clienti ove opportuno in stretta collaborazione con la RM.

L'AM PB assicura la gestione operativa degli account clienti e interagisce con stakeholder interni ed esterni indipendentemente, fornisce ai clienti informazioni pertinenti e supporta le RM nell'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate. Inoltre, l'AM PB funge da modello di riferimento per portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai clienti, agli RM e alle Teste di Team (TH) in modo rapido, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori di Julius Baer (Care, Passione ed Eccellenza) e quindi aiutando il team a gestire e sviluppare la sua attuale base clienti.

L'AM PB si impegna a garantire un'ottima amministrazione del conto, ai clienti e alla Banca e si impegna a fare il mile extra.

Responsabilità Amministrazione e gestione clienti - Assicura che le formalità di documentazione dei rapporti con i clienti siano soddisfatte e mantenute sempre ad un livello elevato, compresa la documentazione di identificazione dei clienti (CDB), i moduli di apertura dei conti e altre forme giuridiche pertinenti - garantisce attivamente che la gestione operativa dei conti sia intrapresa professionalmente, con tutti i compiti/allertelli del sistema eliminati direttamente, ove possibile o tramite RM, se è necessaria una consulenza in materia di investimenti - ove opportuno fa parte di riunioni dei clienti e addirittura conduce parti della riunione (ad esempio:

formalità di documentazione, conformità, altre richieste del cliente) se il caso consente - Actively mantiene i dati chiave del cliente in collegamento con la RM per garantire che CRM e altri set di dati siano corretti per una buona manutenzione del rapporto - Interagisce con i clienti in modo indipendente e professionale in tutti gli aspetti della gestione degli account - Adegua Proattivamente il supporto della RM/TH nel rapporto cliente e in tutte le attività connesse (sistemi, applicazioni, processi, documenti ecc.), con elevata qualità, precisione e tempestività di risposta - Garantisce copertura operativa e interazione con il cliente (non

consulenza) all'interno del team durante le assenze - Compila presentazioni, elabora indipendentemente proposte di investimento e supporta nelle attività di marketing - Crea e fornisce ai clienti informazioni personalizzate, report e statistiche, ecc.

- Gestisce il calendario RM/TH.s, prepara riunioni dei clienti, organizza viaggi di lavoro, completa il post-elaborazione di chiamate dei clienti, riunioni dei clienti o viaggi di lavoro per RMs/THs da solo

Business Management - Gestisce i progetti interni che incidono sui rapporti di conto di una RM, risolvendo direttamente le questioni amministrative che sorgono e assicurando che tutti i sistemi pertinenti siano mantenuti e aggiornati e tutta la documentazione raccolta se necessario - Raccoglie e condivide informazioni, idee, risultati e ricerche pertinenti con i colleghi per migliorare i processi e aumentare la produttività e la qualità - Si organizza in modo efficiente e conforme e garantisce informazioni tempestive e appropriate del superiore - Conduce revisioni, piani avanti e documenti il suo / lei

proprio lavoro in ogni momento - Fornisce proposte di input professionale per miglioramenti basati su esperienza, eventi incidenti o osservazione - Gestisce il processo di reclamo spese per RMs/TH proattivamente

Gestione dei rischi e controlli - Aiuta attivamente a gestire i rischi (sostenere la prima linea di difesa), ossia nella documentazione dei clienti, sollevando preoccupazioni, dando seguito alle questioni indipendentemente e aumentando in caso di dubbio - Garantisce l'osservanza delle normative locali e il rispetto delle politiche e degli standard interni (ad esempio.

nuove aperture di account, istruzioni di pagamento, revisione delle chiamate telefoniche dei clienti o firma a proprio livello di competenza ecc.) in collaborazione con le rispettive RM e TH - Garantisce la tempestiva liquidazione degli elementi pendenti e le carenze aumentate - Garantisce un comportamento etico e conforme appropriato nel suo settore di competenza - Garantisce una documentazione corretta, significativa e comprensibile dell'interazione/degli ordini dei clienti negli strumenti corrispondenti (ad esempio CRM, DiAS)

Requisiti Personal & Social Skills - Eccellente adattabilità situazionale (in grado di lavorare con RM e clienti provenienti da diversi contesti) - Personalità amichevole, affidabile e discreta con un alto livello di consapevolezza del rischio - Approccio proattivo e indipendente al lavoro - Atteggiamento positivo e approcci alle sfide con una mente aperta - Si assume responsabilità extra di propria iniziativa - Altamente orientata al servizio e appassionata sulla manutenzione del cliente - Capacità comunicative eccezionali e comunica sempre in modo amichevole, competente e professionale - Ammira l'eccellenza trovando modi per

fare le cose più intelligenti, più veloce, migliore e non ha paura di mettere in discussione uno status quo - Sistematico, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro e la capacità di eseguire eccessivamente bene sotto pressione - Giocatore di squadra - Alta integrità personale e comportamento etico - è un go-to persona da ad esempio.

aiutare i colleghi, formare altri assistenti, partecipare al programma Buddy.

Capacità professionali - Affinità sana con il mercato geografico (s) coperto, cioè familiarità con il contesto giuridico e normativo nonché consapevolezza culturale - Profonda comprensione dei prodotti, servizi e strumenti pertinenti nel Private Banking - Conoscenza avanzata dei mercati finanziari globali e sviluppi attuali nel settore

Ciò che offriamo Istruzione & Esperienze - O almeno 5 anni di esperienza come ARM o 3 anni di esperienza come ARM e lavoro correlati grado superiore (ad esempio Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), senza contare il periodo di apprendistato - Ottime competenze linguistiche (verbale e scritto) in inglese è un must, altre lingue come tedesco, finlandese e svedese sarebbe un plus - Proven record nel servizio clienti bancari con esigenze complesse (al momento di salire in imbarco di nuovi clienti, mantenere e estendere le relazioni attuali) - Il successo del programma di formazione interna AM PB

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

Titolo di lavoro Ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) Descrizione A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le singole qualità che portate, consentendovi di essere efficaci, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere capaci di creare valore oltre la ricchezza. Lasciamoci plasmare insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.
• Stiamo cercando un esperto ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) per entrare a far parte del nostro team di ingegneria globale della sicurezza a Zurigo. Come candidato ideale, possedete una profonda esperienza in tecnologie di accesso remoto sicuro, forti abilità di autenticazione e integrazione dell'identità e un'esperienza pratica nell'esercizio di piattaforme di connettività remota di livello enterprise all'interno di un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete a vostro agio a lavorare attraverso infrastrutture, sicurezza, endpoint e domini di identità, assicurando che dipendenti, appaltatori e terze parti approvate possano accedere in modo sicuro alle risorse aziendali. Le vostre responsabilità principali saranno l'architettura, il funzionamento e il miglioramento continuo dell'infrastruttura Bank.s Citrix NetScaler Gateway, l'integrazione e il mantenimento di soluzioni di autenticazione multi-fattori, l'applicazione di un accesso sicuro e di politiche di accesso condizionato, e garantire la resilienza, la sicurezza e la conformità dei servizi di accesso remoto della Banca.s. Inoltre, contribuirete alla progettazione, implementazione e implementazione della futura piattaforma Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) e supportate l'evoluzione del paesaggio di accesso remoto verso una moderna architettura Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Lavorando a stretto contatto con IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations e Global IT team, contribuirete a fornire connettività remota sicura, affidabile e scalabile in linea con i requisiti normativi e la tabella di marcia strategica della Banca per la sicurezza. Oltre al dominio di accesso remoto, avrete anche la possibilità di contribuire e acquisire esperienza pratica con altri servizi di sicurezza gestiti dal team, tra cui Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), e Secure Mail Gateway soluzioni. Ciò offre un'ottima opportunità per i candidati che cercano di ampliare la loro esperienza in più settori di sicurezza e sviluppare ulteriormente la loro carriera di ingegneria della sicurezza all'interno di un team collaborativo e altamente qualificato. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You are a member of the System Architects team within global IT Architecture. Together with your colleagues from the Domain and Foundation Architecture teams, you are responsible for designing Solution Architectures.

As a System Architect within the ML & AI ART, you are responsible for defining and aligning the end‑to‑end system architecture for enterprise AI and ML solutions. Your objective is to ensure the ART delivers scalable, secure, and reusable AI capabilities aligned with enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, and business priorities, while enabling efficient and high-quality delivery across teams.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You design and are responsible for the Solution Architecture of applications and AI platform components in delivery

• You ensure that Solution Architectures in delivery adhere to architecture standards and are aligned with the target architectures of the domain

• You initiate architecture decisions, document them as Architecture Decision Records (ADR) and have them approved by the relevant architecture boards

• You advise and coach software engineers on the implementation of Solution Architectures and ensure technical feasibility

Within the ML & AI ART in collaboration with the Lead Architect, you:

• Apply and refine the ART‑level target architecture within team and initiative contexts

• Drive hands‑on architectural design for AI and ML solutions within the teams, balancing consistency while addressing delivery needs

• Support the delivery of key ART initiatives (e.g. the AI automation orchestration layer) by translating high‑level architecture into concrete solution designs

• Ensure alignment and integration with enterprise platforms, data capabilities, security standards, and MLOps services

• Identify architectural risks, dependencies, and technical debt at team and solution level, and escalate them proactively

• Contribute architectural input to PI Planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap discussions from a delivery and feasibility perspective

• Act as the primary architectural contact for assigned teams, while aligning closely with the Lead Architect and other System Architects

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 3 years of experience as a Senior Architect in complex IT environments

• At least 5 years of experience as a Lead or Senior Software Engineer, with hands-on responsibility including practical experience with AI/ML solutions and platforms

• Responsible for solution architectures: from design and implementation to operation

• Ability to identify options for solution architectures and make trade-off architecture decisions

• Collaboratively develop and coordinate solutions with business and technology stakeholders and architecture colleagues

• Proactive mindset, able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

• Practical experience designing and delivering AI and ML solutions in scalable enterprise platforms

• Strong understanding of AI/ML solution patterns, data pipelines, orchestration, and platform integration

• Ability to translate ART- and domain-level target architectures into practical, team-level solution designs

• Experience working across multiple teams while maintaining architectural alignment and consistency

• Ability to identify architectural risks and technical debt early and address them constructively

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain architectural topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field

• Additional certifications are an advantage (e.g. SAFe, cloud, architecture, or AI/ML-related certifications)

• English: business fluent

• Solid foundation in software and system architecture, including modern architectural styles such as event-driven architectures, microservices, and modular monoliths

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and platform integration patterns

• Practical familiarity with AI/ML platforms and ecosystems, including data pipelines, orchestration, and model lifecycle concepts

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and operational considerations in production environments

• Ability to work effectively in agile and SAFe environments using common collaboration and delivery tooling
