At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You are a member of the System Architects team within global IT Architecture. Together with your colleagues from the Domain and Foundation Architecture teams, you are responsible for designing Solution Architectures.

As a System Architect within the ML & AI ART, you are responsible for defining and aligning the end‑to‑end system architecture for enterprise AI and ML solutions. Your objective is to ensure the ART delivers scalable, secure, and reusable AI capabilities aligned with enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, and business priorities, while enabling efficient and high-quality delivery across teams.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You design and are responsible for the Solution Architecture of applications and AI platform components in delivery

• You ensure that Solution Architectures in delivery adhere to architecture standards and are aligned with the target architectures of the domain

• You initiate architecture decisions, document them as Architecture Decision Records (ADR) and have them approved by the relevant architecture boards

• You advise and coach software engineers on the implementation of Solution Architectures and ensure technical feasibility

Within the ML & AI ART in collaboration with the Lead Architect, you:

• Apply and refine the ART‑level target architecture within team and initiative contexts

• Drive hands‑on architectural design for AI and ML solutions within the teams, balancing consistency while addressing delivery needs

• Support the delivery of key ART initiatives (e.g. the AI automation orchestration layer) by translating high‑level architecture into concrete solution designs

• Ensure alignment and integration with enterprise platforms, data capabilities, security standards, and MLOps services

• Identify architectural risks, dependencies, and technical debt at team and solution level, and escalate them proactively

• Contribute architectural input to PI Planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap discussions from a delivery and feasibility perspective

• Act as the primary architectural contact for assigned teams, while aligning closely with the Lead Architect and other System Architects

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 3 years of experience as a Senior Architect in complex IT environments

• At least 5 years of experience as a Lead or Senior Software Engineer, with hands-on responsibility including practical experience with AI/ML solutions and platforms

• Responsible for solution architectures: from design and implementation to operation

• Ability to identify options for solution architectures and make trade-off architecture decisions

• Collaboratively develop and coordinate solutions with business and technology stakeholders and architecture colleagues

• Proactive mindset, able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

• Practical experience designing and delivering AI and ML solutions in scalable enterprise platforms

• Strong understanding of AI/ML solution patterns, data pipelines, orchestration, and platform integration

• Ability to translate ART- and domain-level target architectures into practical, team-level solution designs

• Experience working across multiple teams while maintaining architectural alignment and consistency

• Ability to identify architectural risks and technical debt early and address them constructively

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain architectural topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field

• Additional certifications are an advantage (e.g. SAFe, cloud, architecture, or AI/ML-related certifications)

• English: business fluent

• Solid foundation in software and system architecture, including modern architectural styles such as event-driven architectures, microservices, and modular monoliths

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and platform integration patterns

• Practical familiarity with AI/ML platforms and ecosystems, including data pipelines, orchestration, and model lifecycle concepts

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and operational considerations in production environments

• Ability to work effectively in agile and SAFe environments using common collaboration and delivery tooling

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Business Manager Intermediaries will serve as a fully integrated role bridging central coordination and on-site operational support across the Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas. Combining the strategic and tactical responsibilities, this position ensures efficient execution of global initiatives while providing responsive, market-level support to front-line leaders and stakeholders.

Acting as a two-way conduit between Internal Units and the respective Intermediaries Market, the Business Manager Intermediaries drives alignment, enhances communication, and supports sustainable business growth through structured coordination and operational excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Front-Line Operational Support

• Provide direct assistance to the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, as well as ad-hoc support to Group Heads and Relationship Managers

• Organize and coordinate Management Committees, regular business reviews and strategy sessions

• Track action items etc.; ensure accountability and follow-through

Strategic Coordination & Governance

• Serve as primary liaison between the Intermediaries segment, in particular Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, and central/global functions (e.g., Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operations), facilitating smooth exchange of information and requirements

• Coordinate the implementation of bank-wide projects, initiatives, and regulatory changes at the market level, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards

• Represent the Intermediaries segment in cross-functional working groups; contribute market-relevant perspectives to shaping strategies and solutions

Top-Down Execution

• Receive, evaluate, and prepare centrally driven topics for local adaptation and distribution

• Disseminate approved directives, guidelines, and campaign materials to front-line units

• Monitor execution progress, identify roadblocks, and report outcomes back to central stakeholders

Bottom-Up Escalation

• Act as first point of contact for front-line inputs, feedback, and proposals; conduct initial assessment and prioritization

• Consolidate, refine, and forward relevant market-generated content to central bodies for consideration or action

• Advocate for practical adjustments based on real-world constraints or client needs

Project & Process Management

• Develop presentations, briefing notes, status updates, and decision dossiers for senior management

• Identify recurring inefficiencies and propose structural improvements

• Lead or co-manage workstreams

Deputy Function

• Step in to handle key business management tasks when needed, ensuring smooth operations during absences or busy periods

YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline (Master’s degree considered advantageous)

• Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience within private banking, wealth management, or financial services, with demonstrated exposure to both operational support and strategic coordination

• Prior experience in a business management, executive support, or intermediary-facing role strongly preferred

• Solid understanding of Swiss banking practices, regulatory expectations, and front-office workflows

Required Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional enthusiasm, with excellent organizational and time-management abilities with keen attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in synthesizing complex information into clear summaries

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English (additional fluency in Spanish and/or German is highly beneficial)

• High level of autonomy combined with teamwork orientation and service-mindedness

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Gli Intermediari di Business Manager serviranno come un ruolo completamente integrato che corrode il coordinamento centrale e il supporto operativo in loco attraverso gli Intermediari di mercato della Svizzera occidentale e delle Americhe. Combinando le responsabilità strategiche e tattiche, questa posizione garantisce un'esecuzione efficiente delle iniziative globali, fornendo supporto reattivo e di livello di mercato ai leader e agli stakeholder di prima linea.

Agendo come un condotto a due vie tra le unità interne e il rispettivo mercato intermedio, gli intermediari di Business Manager guida l'allineamento, migliora la comunicazione e supporta la crescita aziendale sostenibile attraverso il coordinamento strutturato e l'eccellenza operativa.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Supporto operativo a prima linea

• Fornire assistenza diretta agli Intermediari di Market Head Western Svizzera & Americas, nonché supporto ad-hoc ai responsabili di Gruppo e Relazioni

• Organizzare e coordinare comitati di gestione, regolari recensioni aziendali e sessioni di strategia

• Monitorare gli elementi di azione ecc.; garantire la responsabilità e il follow-through

Coordinamento strategico e governance

• Serve come collegamento primario tra il segmento Intermediari, in particolare Intermediari di Mercato Svizzera occidentale e Americas, e funzioni centrali/globali (ad esempio, Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operazioni), facilitando lo scambio regolare di informazioni e requisiti

• Coordinare l'implementazione di progetti, iniziative e cambiamenti normativi a livello di mercato, assicurando l'adesione a tempi e standard di qualità

• Rappresentare il segmento Intermediari in gruppi di lavoro interfunzionali; contribuire prospettive di mercato rilevanti per modellare strategie e soluzioni

Esecuzione top-down

• Ricevi, valuta e prepara argomenti guidati centralmente per l'adattamento e la distribuzione locali

• Disseminare le direttive, le linee guida e i materiali di campagna approvati alle unità di prima linea

• Monitorare i progressi dell'esecuzione, identificare i blocchi stradali e riportare i risultati alle parti interessate centrali

Escalation inferiore

• Agire come primo punto di contatto per ingressi, feedback e proposte di prima linea; condurre la valutazione iniziale e la priorità

• Consolidare, perfezionare e trasmettere contenuti generati dal mercato agli organismi centrali per la considerazione o l'azione

• Avvocato per adeguamenti pratici basati su vincoli reali o esigenze del cliente

Gestione dei progetti e dei processi

• Sviluppare presentazioni, note di briefing, aggiornamenti di stato e dossier di decisione per la gestione senior

• Identificare inefficienze ricorrenti e proporre miglioramenti strutturali

• Flussi di lavoro di piombo o cogestione

Funzione aggiuntiva

• Passo per gestire i compiti chiave di gestione aziendale quando necessario, assicurando operazioni fluide durante le assenze o periodi occupati

Il tuo progetto
Qualifiche e esperienza

• Corso di laurea in Business Administration, finanza, economia, o una disciplina correlata (il grado di Master considerato vantaggioso)

• Esperienza professionale minima di 5 anni all’interno del private banking, della gestione patrimoniale o dei servizi finanziari, con esposizione dimostrata al supporto operativo e al coordinamento strategico

• Esperienza prioritaria in una gestione aziendale, supporto esecutivo o ruolo intermedio fortemente preferito

• Solida comprensione delle pratiche bancarie svizzere, delle aspettative normative e dei flussi di lavoro di front-office

Competenze e competenze necessarie

• Eccezionale entusiasmo, con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo con cura attenta ai dettagli

• Forte capacità analitiche con competenza nel sintetizzare informazioni complesse in sintesi chiare

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in francese e inglese (influenza aggiuntiva in spagnolo e/o tedesco è altamente vantaggioso)

• Alto livello di autonomia combinato con l'orientamento del lavoro di squadra e la mentalità del servizio

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Business Manager Intermediaries wird als voll integrierte Rolle die zentrale Koordination und operative Unterstützung vor Ort in den Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas überbrücken. Durch die Kombination der strategischen und taktischen Verantwortlichkeiten gewährleistet diese Position eine effiziente Umsetzung globaler Initiativen und bietet gleichzeitig eine reaktionsschnelle Unterstützung auf Marktebene für Führungskräfte und Interessengruppen an vorderster Front.

Als Zwei-Wege-Verbindung zwischen internen Einheiten und dem jeweiligen Intermediärmarkt fördert der Business Manager Intermediär die Ausrichtung, verbessert die Kommunikation und unterstützt nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum durch strukturierte Koordination und operative Exzellenz.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
Frontline-Betriebsunterstützung

• Direkte Unterstützung für die Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas sowie Ad-hoc-Unterstützung für Group Heads und Relationship Manager

• Organisation und Koordination von Management Committees, regelmäßigen Business Reviews und Strategiesitzungen

• Track Action Items usw.; Gewährleistung von Rechenschaftspflicht und Folgemaßnahmen

Strategische Koordination und Governance

• Dienen als primäre Verbindung zwischen dem Segment Intermediaries, insbesondere Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, und zentralen/globalen Funktionen (z.B. Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operations) und ermöglichen einen reibungslosen Austausch von Informationen und Anforderungen.

• Koordinieren Sie die Umsetzung bankweiter Projekte, Initiativen und regulatorischer Änderungen auf Marktebene und gewährleisten Sie die Einhaltung von Zeitplänen und Qualitätsstandards

• Vertretung des Segments Intermediaries in funktionsübergreifenden Arbeitsgruppen; Mitwirkung marktrelevanter Perspektiven bei der Gestaltung von Strategien und Lösungen

Top-Down Ausführung

• Empfangen, Bewerten und Aufbereiten zentral gesteuerter Themen für die lokale Anpassung und Verteilung

• Verbreitung genehmigter Richtlinien, Richtlinien und Kampagnenmaterialien an Fronteinheiten

• Überwachung des Ausführungsfortschritts, Identifizierung von Hindernissen und Rückmeldung der Ergebnisse an zentrale Stakeholder

Bottom-Up Eskalation

• Handeln Sie als erster Ansprechpartner für Front-Line-Inputs, Feedback und Vorschläge; führen Sie eine erste Bewertung und Priorisierung durch

• Konsolidierung, Verfeinerung und Weiterleitung relevanter marktgenerierter Inhalte an zentrale Stellen zur Prüfung oder zum Handeln

• Befürworten Sie praktische Anpassungen basierend auf realen Einschränkungen oder Kundenbedürfnissen

Projekt- und Prozessmanagement

• Entwicklung von Präsentationen, Briefing-Notizen, Status-Updates und Entscheidungsdossiers für die Geschäftsleitung

• Wiederkehrende Ineffizienzen identifizieren und strukturelle Verbesserungen vorschlagen

• Führen oder Mitverwalten von Workstreams

Stellvertretende Funktion

• Treten Sie ein, um bei Bedarf wichtige betriebswirtschaftliche Aufgaben zu erledigen und einen reibungslosen Betrieb während Abwesenheiten oder Geschäftszeiten zu gewährleisten

IHR PROFIL
Qualifikationen & Erfahrung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin (Master-Abschluss als vorteilhaft angesehen)

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Private Banking, Wealth Management oder Finanzdienstleistungen mit nachgewiesener operativer Unterstützung und strategischer Koordination

• Vorkenntnisse in einer Unternehmensführung, Executive Support oder Vermittlerrolle stark bevorzugt

• Solides Verständnis der Schweizer Bankpraktiken, regulatorischen Erwartungen und Front-Office-Workflows

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen

• Außergewöhnlicher Enthusiasmus mit hervorragenden organisatorischen und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten mit viel Liebe zum Detail

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Kenntnissen in der Synthese komplexer Informationen in klaren Zusammenfassungen

• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Französisch und Englisch (zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse in Spanisch und / oder Deutsch sind sehr vorteilhaft)

• Hohe Autonomie gepaart mit Teamwork-Orientierung und Servicebewusstsein

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le Business Manager Intermediaries jouera un rôle pleinement intégré qui reliera la coordination centrale et le soutien opérationnel sur place dans les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques. Combinant les responsabilités stratégiques et tactiques, ce poste assure l'exécution efficace des initiatives mondiales tout en fournissant un soutien adapté au niveau du marché aux dirigeants de première ligne et aux intervenants.

Agissant comme un canal bidirectionnel entre les unités internes et le marché des intermédiaires, le Business Manager Intermediaries stimule l'alignement, améliore la communication et soutient la croissance durable des entreprises par une coordination structurée et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre défi
Soutien opérationnel de première ligne

• Fournir une assistance directe aux intermédiaires du marché Suisse occidentale et Amériques, ainsi qu'un soutien ad hoc aux chefs de groupe et aux gestionnaires de relations

• Organiser et coordonner des comités de gestion, des examens réguliers des activités et des séances de stratégie

• Suivre les mesures à prendre, etc.; assurer la responsabilisation et le suivi

Coordination stratégique et gouvernance

• Servir de liaison principale entre le segment des intermédiaires, en particulier les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques, et les fonctions centrales et mondiales (p. ex., conformité, TI, marketing, opérations), en facilitant l'échange d'informations et les exigences

• Coordonner la mise en oeuvre de projets, d'initiatives et de changements réglementaires à l'échelle de la banque au niveau du marché, en veillant au respect des délais et des normes de qualité

• Représenter le segment des intermédiaires dans les groupes de travail interfonctionnels; contribuer à l'élaboration de stratégies et de solutions en fonction du marché

Exécution de haut niveau

• Reçoit, évalue et prépare des thèmes centralisés pour l'adaptation et la distribution locales

• Diffuser les directives, lignes directrices et matériel de campagne approuvés aux unités de première ligne

• Surveiller les progrès de l'exécution, identifier les barrages routiers et rendre compte des résultats aux intervenants centraux

Escalade ascendante

• Agir comme premier point de contact pour les contributions, les commentaires et les propositions de première ligne; procéder à une évaluation initiale et établir des priorités

• Consolider, affiner et transmettre le contenu pertinent généré par le marché aux organes centraux pour examen ou action

• Plaidoyer pour des ajustements pratiques basés sur les contraintes réelles ou les besoins des clients

Gestion de projet et de processus

• Élaborer des présentations, des notes d'information, des mises à jour et des dossiers de décision pour la haute direction

• Identifier les inefficacités récurrentes et proposer des améliorations structurelles

• Secteurs de travail du plomb ou de la cogestion

Fonction adjointe

• Étape dans la gestion des tâches clés de gestion d'entreprise au besoin, en assurant des opérations en douceur pendant les absences ou les périodes occupées

VOTRE PROFIL
Qualifications et expérience

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, économie, ou une discipline connexe (diplôme de maîtrise considéré comme avantageux)

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein de la banque privée, de la gestion de patrimoine ou des services financiers, avec une exposition démontrée au soutien opérationnel et à la coordination stratégique

• Expérience antérieure dans un rôle de gestion d'entreprise, de soutien aux cadres ou d'intermédiaire fortement préféré

• Une bonne compréhension des pratiques bancaires suisses, des attentes en matière de réglementation et des flux de travail de première ligne

Compétences requises

• Un enthousiasme exceptionnel, avec d'excellentes capacités organisationnelles et de gestion du temps avec une attention particulière aux détails

• Fortes compétences analytiques en synthèse d'informations complexes

• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais (une maîtrise supplémentaire en espagnol et/ou en allemand est très bénéfique)

• Niveau élevé d'autonomie associé à l'orientation du travail d'équipe et à l'esprit de service

• Integrate Data Quality with Data Governance and Catalog

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This is a challenging and interesting role as a legal counsel with a focus on legal and regulatory matters in relation to the provision of financial services (advisory and discretionary management) as well wealth planning solutions within the team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

The team consists of highly qualified lawyers located at the Head Office in Zurich. The team is part of the General Counsel Wealth Management sub-division and provides legal advice to our stakeholders, including senior management from the Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) of Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Our work is truly international as we closely collaborate with other teams around the globe with the aim to provide tailor-made solutions with a hands-on approach. We are a dynamic, highly motivated team and pride ourselves in our excellent team spirit and supportive atmosphere.

This global role has a multijurisdictional scope, allows you to work on a wide variety of contractual and regulatory topics in relation to onshore and cross-border financial and wealth planning services. From the very beginning, you will handle your own portfolio of tasks. You therefore have a direct impact on Julius Baer’s legal affairs and business. You will also have a close working relationship with compliance, front office and front risk management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as legal expert for financial and wealth planning services (including advisory and discretionary mandate services, as well as trust, pension and life insurance solutions)

• Assess and review B2B documentation and agreements, particularly with external partners and providers, in relation to wealth planning services

• Provide guidance to senior management and internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments in Switzerland and assess potential risks related to cross-border service provision (incl. civil liability and regulatory risks)

• Support legal colleagues participating in internal committees by providing wealth planning expertise

• Contribute to strategic projects and deliver ad-hoc legal support, offering efficient, client-oriented solutions related to FinSA and MiFID

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree in law (preferably from a Swiss University) and admission to the bar; additional qualifications such as an LL.M. are an asset

• 1-3 years of professional experience, preferably in a law firm, financial institution of consulting firm

• Profound understanding of Swiss banking and contract law as well as the Swiss regulatory landscape

• Analytical, structured and solution orientated with a proactive approach and capable of translating legal requirements into business-oriented solutions

• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and as a team-player in groups

• Ability to perform under pressure and efficiently handle different competing tasks and priorities

• Good communication skills and a natural capacity to convincingly share ideas

• Excellent proficiency in English and German, knowledge of additional languages is considered an advantage

Si tratta di un ruolo impegnativo e interessante come consulente legale con un focus su questioni legali e regolamentari in relazione alla fornitura di servizi finanziari (gestione di consulenza e discrezione) e soluzioni di pianificazione patrimoniale all'interno del team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

Il team è composto da avvocati altamente qualificati situati presso la sede centrale di Zurigo. Il team fa parte della divisione General Counsel Wealth Management e fornisce consulenza legale ai nostri stakeholder, tra cui la gestione senior della Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) di Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Il nostro lavoro è veramente internazionale mentre collaboriamo a stretto contatto con altre squadre in tutto il mondo con l'obiettivo di fornire soluzioni su misura con un approccio pratico. Siamo un team dinamico e altamente motivato e siamo orgogliosi del nostro eccellente spirito di squadra e dell'atmosfera di supporto.

Questo ruolo globale ha una portata multigiurisdizionale, consente di lavorare su una vasta gamma di argomenti contrattuali e regolamentari in relazione ai servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale onshore e transfrontaliera. Fin dall'inizio, gestirai il tuo portafoglio di compiti. Avete quindi un impatto diretto sugli affari legali e gli affari di Julius Baer. Avrete anche una stretta relazione di lavoro con la conformità, l'ufficio frontale e la gestione del rischio anteriore.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Atto come esperto legale per i servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale (inclusi servizi di consulenza e mandato discrezionale, così come soluzioni di fiducia, pensione e assicurazione sulla vita)

• Valutare e rivedere la documentazione e gli accordi B2B, in particolare con partner esterni e fornitori, in relazione ai servizi di pianificazione patrimoniale

• Fornire una guida alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder interni su progetti e iniziative

• Sostenere i colleghi legali che partecipano ai comitati interni fornendo competenze di pianificazione della ricchezza

• Contribuire a progetti strategici e fornire supporto giuridico ad-hoc, offrendo soluzioni efficienti e orientate al cliente relative a FinSA e MiFID

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale in diritto (preferibilmente presso un'Università Svizzera) e ammissione al bar; qualifiche aggiuntive come un LL.M. sono un bene

• 1-3 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in uno studio legale, istituzione finanziaria di società di consulenza

• Una profonda comprensione del diritto bancario e contrattuale svizzero e del paesaggio normativo svizzero

• Analitico, strutturato e soluzione orientato con un approccio proattivo e capace di tradurre i requisiti legali in soluzioni orientate al business

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come giocatore di squadra in gruppi

• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione e gestire in modo efficiente diversi compiti e priorità concorrenti

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e una capacità naturale di condividere con convinzione idee

• Ottima competenza in inglese e tedesco, la conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è considerata un vantaggio

Il s'agit d'un rôle stimulant et intéressant en tant que conseiller juridique qui met l'accent sur les questions juridiques et réglementaires liées à la prestation de services financiers (gestion consultative et discrétionnaire) ainsi que sur les solutions de planification de patrimoine au sein de l'équipe Solutions d'investissement et distribution juridiques.

L'équipe est composée d'avocats hautement qualifiés situés au siège social de Zurich. L'équipe fait partie de la division General Counsel Wealth Management et fournit des conseils juridiques à nos intervenants, y compris à la haute direction de la Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) de Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Notre travail est vraiment international car nous collaborons étroitement avec d'autres équipes du monde entier dans le but de fournir des solutions sur mesure avec une approche pratique. Nous sommes une équipe dynamique et très motivée et nous sommes fiers de notre excellent esprit d'équipe et de notre atmosphère de soutien.

Ce rôle mondial a une portée multigouvernementale, vous permet de travailler sur une grande variété de sujets contractuels et réglementaires en relation avec les services financiers et de planification de patrimoine à terre et transfrontaliers. Dès le début, vous gérerez votre propre portefeuille de tâches. Vous avez donc un impact direct sur les affaires juridiques et les affaires de Julius Baer. Vous aurez également une relation de travail étroite avec la conformité, le front office et la gestion des risques frontaux.

Votre défi

• Agir en tant qu'expert juridique en matière de services financiers et de planification du patrimoine (y compris les services de conseil et de mandat discrétionnaire, ainsi que les solutions en matière de fiducie, de pension et d'assurance-vie)

• Évaluer et examiner la documentation et les ententes B2B, en particulier avec des partenaires et des fournisseurs externes, en ce qui concerne les services de planification du patrimoine

• Fournir des conseils à la haute direction et aux intervenants internes sur les projets et les initiatives

• Surveiller les évolutions juridiques et réglementaires en Suisse et évaluer les risques potentiels liés à la prestation de services transfrontaliers (y compris la responsabilité civile et les risques réglementaires)

• Appuyer les collègues juridiques qui participent aux comités internes en fournissant une expertise en planification de patrimoine

• Contribuer aux projets stratégiques et fournir un soutien juridique ad hoc, offrant des solutions efficaces et orientées client liées à FinSA et MiFID

VOTRE PROFIL

• Maîtrise en droit (de préférence d'une université suisse) et admission au barreau; des diplômes supplémentaires comme un LL.M. sont un atout

• 1-3 ans d'expérience professionnelle, de préférence dans un cabinet d'avocats, institution financière du cabinet de conseil

• Connaissance approfondie du droit bancaire et du droit des contrats suisses ainsi que du paysage réglementaire suisse

• Analyse, structure et solution orientée vers une approche proactive et capable de traduire les exigences juridiques en solutions orientées vers l'entreprise

• Un état d'esprit proactif et orienté vers la solution avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en tant que joueur d'équipe en groupe

• Aptitude à effectuer sous pression et à gérer efficacement différentes tâches et priorités concurrentes

• Bonnes compétences en communication et capacité naturelle de partager des idées de manière convaincante

• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand, connaissance de langues supplémentaires est considéré comme un avantage

jobs.title: Data Platform Responsible 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Data Platform Responsible (PR) you are responsible for the end-to-end technical leadership and lifecycle management of a global data platform (datalake house) ensuring alignment with business needs, architecture standards, and operational resilience. Working closely with Product Owners, Platform Owner, System Architects, and IT Service Owners, the Platform Responsible supports technical decision-making, oversees solution design and drives technical decision-making, responsible for successful development execution, and ensures production readiness and release planning within defined frameworks. The role combines hands-on technical oversight with supplier management, risk assessment, quality assurance, and deep involvement in agile delivery and incident support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You are key technical stakeholder in the technical design of a Global Platform based on a modern infrastructure

• You are part of the agile setup and support development team

• Lead the technical design, development, and operational performance of the platform, ensuring full lifecycle management and compliance with corporate standards

• Contribute to platforms technical roadmap, including technology changes, modernisation, and decommissioning, in alignment with business and architectural strategies

• Own and contribute to key deliverables including Solution Design, Security Concept, and Interface Agreements; ensure adherence to architecture standards in collaboration with the System Architect

• Plan and coordinate application releases in line with Change- and Release Management processes, jointly deciding on production go-live with the Product Owner, Platform Owner and ITSO

• Supervise platform infrastructure and data development activities, promote “shift-left” practices (automation, unit testing, CI/CD), and ensure robust implementation of functional and non-functional requirements

• Provide 3rd level support, serve as master data custodian in JBAR, and lead supplier management for third-party applications, including performance and delivery oversight

• Estimate effort for changes, advise on technical risks and mitigation, support budgeting, and ensure technical requirements are properly validated and tested prior to release

• You feel responsible for the global data platform which serves global data for different analytics use cases and ensure a running and stable environment

• Support the System Architect in the raising and maintenance of technical debts

• Support Business Responsible and IT Product Owner in shaping platform service and its execution

• Collaboration with support teams in Asia to ensure enhanced support hours

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake houses (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage like S3/HDFS) – preferably On prem.

• Several years of work experience in a similar capacity in the financial industry

• Experience in leading technical direction of data platforms, keeping up to date with the modern possibilities of tooling, formats, concepts.

• Experience in managing the full platform lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, deployment, operation, and eventual retirement, including responsibility for master data, incident support, and release coordination

• VM setup and scaling (pods), K8S scaling, managing Docker with Harbor, pushing Images through CI/CD together with development team

• Higher Education in Computer Science (University, University of Applied Sciences or equivalent diploma)

• Very strong communication and planning / coordination skills

• Willingness to bring in new ideas and initiate changes and sees themselves as proactive, reliable and solution driven

• Good English language skills (written and verbal), German a plus

• Strong team player

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Very good understanding of data technology and its operational management

• Very high level on self-motivation to drive initiatives and initiating changes

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Global Products & Solutions plays a central role in shaping client-focused investment strategies, developing innovative financial products, and providing expert advisory across all major asset classes. By aligning global insights with local needs, we empower relationship managers with tailored solutions that meet evolving client needs.
In this role, the primary responsibilities include shaping and driving the global strategic agenda for GPS. This entails spearheading strategic growth initiatives that align with the Bank’s overarching strategy, ensuring strong alignment across regions, and ensure they are based on client demand. The individual shall partner closely with business owners/stewards to identify, assess and drive new business opportunities.

The role also requires assessing strategic partnerships as well as inorganic business opportunities (e.g. M&As, establishment of joint ventures) from a GPS perspective. Further, the individual shall coordinate cross-unit collaboration, drive insight generation through robust market and competitor analysis, and support senior management with recommendations and decision-making.

The role will report to the Head of GPS Strategy & Business Development (Switzerland & Europe).

YOUR CHALLENGE
Stakeholder management (internal & external)

• Drive global strategic growth initiatives that align with the Group’s overall strategic priorities

• Partner with GPS business owners/stewards to identify, evaluate, and drive new business opportunities and partnerships and outline growth plans

• Support all GPS teams in project and change management activities

• Work in close collaboration with Group Strategy and Group Finance to support the end-to-end execution of strategic initiatives

Business management

• Define and drive the ambitions/objectives of the team in consultation with Head of GPS Strategy & Business Development (Switzerland & Europe)

• Synthesise complex data sets and qualitative insights into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations

• Support the development and delivery of high-quality strategy papers, market analyses, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders across GPS

• Assess strategic partnerships/joint ventures and inorganic business opportunities (e.g. M&As, establishment of joint ventures) from a GPS perspective

• Drive front-to-back rollout of new business projects/key initiatives aligned with the established agile IT delivery governance, ensuring that objectives, ownership, and tangible outcomes are clearly outlined and tracked

• Monitor emerging technologies, innovations, disruptions, and latest market trends across global markets

• Provide inputs/updates of GPS for the various management committees

Regulatory responsibilities and/or risk management

• Meet all legal, regulatory, and compliance standards/requirements

• Adhere to the standards and expectations outlined in the relevant user manuals and guidelines

• Demonstrate appropriate values and behaviours including, but not limited to standards on honesty and integrity, due care and diligence, fair dealing (treating customers fairly), management of conflicts of interest, competence and continuous development, adequate risk management, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations

YOUR PROFILE

• Solid banking knowledge, especially with GPS related topics such as lending, structured products and ultra clients advisory

• Around 5 years or more of private banking knowledge and experience

• Relevant higher educational and professional background

• Good command of financial analytical skills

• Strong commercial judgement, business acumen and a broad understanding of the financial markets and products

• Strategic thinking skills and capacity to quickly grasps the big picture while offering solutions to very specific topics

• Able to effectively manage internal and external stakeholders from diverse backgrounds in a highly articulate and professional manner

• Open and approachable as well as displaying genuine interest in people

• Drive for results and ability to work under pressure

• Strong ability for planning, organising, and communicating a clear vision

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

• Valutare partenariati strategici / joint venture e opportunità di business inorganiche (ad esempio M&As, creazione di joint ventures) da una prospettiva GPS
• Guidare l'implementazione front-to-back di nuovi progetti aziendali / iniziative chiave allineate con la governance consolidata di distribuzione IT, assicurando che obiettivi, proprietà e risultati tangibili siano chiaramente delineati e tracciati
• Monitorare le tecnologie emergenti, le innovazioni, le interruzioni e le ultime tendenze del mercato nei mercati globali
• Fornire ingressi/aggiornamento del GPS per i vari comitati di gestione Responsabilità e/o gestione del rischio
• Soddisfare tutti gli standard legali, regolamentari e conformitÃ / requisiti

• Dimostrare valori e comportamenti appropriati, tra cui, ma non limitati alle norme sull'onestà e l'integrità, la cura e la diligenza, il corretto trattamento (trattare i clienti in modo equo), la gestione dei conflitti di interesse, di competenza e di sviluppo continuo, una gestione adeguata del rischio e il rispetto delle leggi e dei regolamenti applicabili Il tuo progetto
• Conoscenze bancarie solide, in particolare con argomenti relativi al GPS come prestiti, prodotti strutturati e consulenza clienti ultra
• Circa 5 anni o più di conoscenza e esperienza bancaria privata
• Sfondo educativo e professionale superiore rilevante
• Buon comando delle competenze analitiche finanziarie
• Forte giudizio commerciale, acume aziendale e una vasta comprensione dei mercati finanziari e dei prodotti
• Capacità di pensiero strategico e capacità di cogliere rapidamente il grande quadro offrendo soluzioni a temi molto specifici
• In grado di gestire efficacemente le parti interessate interne ed esterne da contesti diversi in modo altamente articolato e professionale
• Aperto e accessibile, oltre a mostrare interesse genuino per le persone

In dieser Rolle besteht die Hauptaufgabe darin, die globale strategische Agenda für GPS zu gestalten und voranzutreiben. Dies beinhaltet die Speerspitze strategischer Wachstumsinitiativen, die mit der übergreifenden Strategie der Bank in Einklang stehen, eine starke Ausrichtung zwischen den Regionen sicherstellen und sicherstellen, dass sie auf der Nachfrage der Kunden basieren. Die Person muss eng mit Unternehmern / Verwaltern zusammenarbeiten, um neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und zu fördern. Die Rolle erfordert auch die Bewertung strategischer Partnerschaften sowie anorganischer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten (z. B. M&As, Gründung von Joint Ventures) aus einer GPS-Perspektive. Darüber hinaus koordiniert die Einzelperson die abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, treibt die Generierung von Erkenntnissen durch robuste Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen voran und unterstützt das Management bei Empfehlungen und Entscheidungen. • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Group Strategy und Group Finance zur Unterstützung der End-to-End-Durchführung strategischer Initiativen Unternehmensführung
• Definieren und treiben Sie die Ambitionen/Ziele des Teams in Absprache mit dem Leiter GPS Strategy & Business Development (Schweiz & Europa)
• Synthetisieren Sie komplexe Datensätze und qualitative Einblicke in klare, prägnante und visuell überzeugende Präsentationen
• Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung hochwertiger Strategiepapiere, Marktanalysen und umsetzbarer Empfehlungen für hochrangige Stakeholder über GPS hinweg
• Bewerten Sie strategische Partnerschaften / Joint Ventures und anorganische Geschäftsmöglichkeiten (z. B. M&As, Gründung von Joint Ventures) aus GPS-Sicht
• Front-to-Back-Rollout neuer Geschäftsprojekte / Schlüsselinitiativen, die auf die etablierte agile IT-Delivery-Governance ausgerichtet sind, um sicherzustellen, dass Ziele, Eigentümerschaft und greifbare Ergebnisse klar umrissen und verfolgt werden
• Überwachen Sie aufkommende Technologien, Innovationen, Störungen und neueste Markttrends auf den globalen Märkten

C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Global Products & Solutions joue un rôle central dans l'élaboration de stratégies d'investissement axées sur les clients, le développement de produits financiers innovants et la fourniture de conseils d'experts dans toutes les grandes catégories d'actifs. En alignant les connaissances mondiales sur les besoins locaux, nous autonomisons les gestionnaires de relations avec des solutions adaptées aux besoins changeants des clients. Dans ce rôle, les principales responsabilités comprennent l'élaboration et le pilotage du programme stratégique mondial pour le GPS. Cela implique de mener des initiatives stratégiques de croissance qui s'alignent sur la stratégie globale de la Banque, assurent une forte harmonisation entre les régions et s'assurent qu'elles sont fondées sur la demande des clients. L'individu doit s'associer étroitement avec les propriétaires ou les dirigeants d'entreprise pour identifier, évaluer et exploiter de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires. Le rôle exige aussi d'évaluer les partenariats stratégiques ainsi que les possibilités d'affaires inorganiques (p. ex., les fusions et acquisitions, la création de coentreprises) du point de vue du GPS. En outre, l'individu doit coordonner la collaboration entre les unités, favoriser la production de connaissances grâce à une analyse robuste du marché et des concurrents, et aider la haute direction à formuler des recommandations et à prendre des décisions. Ce rôle sera confié au responsable de la stratégie GPS et du développement des entreprises (Suisse et Europe). Votre défi Gestion des parties prenantes (interne et externe)
• Encourager les initiatives stratégiques mondiales de croissance qui correspondent aux priorités stratégiques globales du Groupe
• Établir des partenariats avec les propriétaires et les dirigeants d'entreprises du GPS afin de cerner, d'évaluer et de stimuler de nouvelles occasions d'affaires et de nouveaux partenariats et de définir des plans de croissance
• Soutenir toutes les équipes GPS dans les activités de gestion de projet et de changement
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Groupe Stratégie et le Groupe Finance pour appuyer l'exécution de bout en bout des initiatives stratégiques Gestion des entreprises

• Synthétiser des ensembles de données complexes et des aperçus qualitatifs sur des présentations claires, concises et visuellement convaincantes
• Appuyer l'élaboration et la diffusion de documents de stratégie de haute qualité, d'analyses de marché et de recommandations pratiques à l'intention des intervenants de haut niveau dans l'ensemble du GPS
• Évaluer les partenariats stratégiques et les coentreprises et les occasions d'affaires inorganiques (p. ex., fusions et acquisitions, création de coentreprises) du point de vue du GPS
• Faire en sorte que le déploiement des nouveaux projets opérationnels et des initiatives clés s'harmonise avec la gouvernance agile de la prestation de la TI établie, en veillant à ce que les objectifs, la propriété et les résultats tangibles soient clairement décrits et suivis.
• Surveiller les nouvelles technologies, les innovations, les perturbations et les dernières tendances du marché sur les marchés mondiaux
• Fournir des contributions/mises à jour du GPS aux divers comités de gestion Responsabilités réglementaires et/ou gestion des risques
• Respecter toutes les normes et exigences juridiques, réglementaires et de conformité
• Respecter les normes et attentes énoncées dans les manuels et lignes directrices pertinents
• Démontrer des valeurs et des comportements appropriés, y compris, sans s'y limiter, des normes d'honnêteté et d'intégrité, de diligence et de diligence, de traitement équitable des clients, de gestion des conflits d'intérêts, de compétence et de développement continu, de gestion adéquate des risques et de conformité aux lois et règlements applicables VOTRE PROFIL
• Connaissances bancaires solides, en particulier sur des sujets liés au GPS tels que le prêt, les produits structurés et les conseils ultra-clients
• Environ 5 ans ou plus de connaissances et d'expérience en banque privée
• Enseignement supérieur et formation professionnelle
• Bonne maîtrise des techniques d'analyse financière
• Un jugement commercial fort, un sens des affaires et une compréhension large des marchés et des produits financiers
• Compétences de réflexion stratégique et capacité à saisir rapidement l'image globale tout en offrant des solutions à des sujets très spécifiques
• Capacité à gérer efficacement les intervenants internes et externes de divers horizons de manière hautement articulée et professionnelle
• Ouverte et accessible et présentant un véritable intérêt pour les gens
• Conduire pour obtenir des résultats et la capacité de travailler sous pression

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We seek a highly skilled Wealth Planner to join Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning based in Zurich, Switzerland. Wealth Planning, a unit of Global Products & Solutions (GPS), is a core offering of the JB Group and provides specialist wealth planning to support Relationship Managers (RMs) in acquiring, maintaining, and retaining private client relationships. Your main responsibility will be to provide wealth planning guidance and introduce wealth planning products and solutions to meet the needs of our private clients.

The successful candidate will stand out for their ability to deliver excellence in two key areas. The first is as subject matter expert in Latin American markets where agility in wealth planning topics including philanthropy, relocation, succession planning, taxation and wealth structuring will be needed. (Proven experience in Mexico, but not only, will be a distinct advantage.) The second is in relation to our key client and ultra-high net worth segment, which is more universal and less country-specific in nature. Here, experience in family governance topics and harmonizing these with the wealth structures needed will distinguish the ideal profile.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide strategic wealth planning guidance to RMs and their clients, actively coordinating the wealth planning process by leveraging internal and external experts as needed

• Implement suitable solutions, such as private insurance, private trusts, private foundations or private companies in collaboration with internal and external providers

• Serve as a subject matter specialist in client-facing interactions, following the JB Advisory Process which includes fact-finding, analysis, discussion of principles, evaluation of concepts, proposal of solutions/services, implementation and follow-up

• Support the Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team in delivering services to UHNW prospects and clients, by applying WP’s offering, with focus on Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (including Philanthropy Advisory) and Family Governance, amongst others

• Stay up to date with industry, legal, regulatory and taxation changes, and inform clients and internal stakeholders accordingly

• Support RMs and other stakeholders by providing training, knowledge transfer and assistance on wealth planning topics and services/products

YOUR PROFILE
Professional Qualifications & Education

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in relevant financial services sectors or comparable private client practices (e.g. private bank, legal practice, tax advisor, fiduciary company)

• University degree in Law (a Latin American country qualification), master in tax or a related field is a must. Additional qualifications on family governance and experience in servicing private clients would be of advantage. Additional courses linked to the area of expertise, such as STEP accreditation, are preferred

Experience & Competencies

• Client-centric approach. Passion for wealth planning advice for private HNW and UHNW individuals

• Engaging personality with the ability to work effectively with high-net-worth clients, ensuring their needs and objectives are met

• Travel to win, maintain and retain Clients will be required on an ad hoc basis, including to Latin America

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong work ethic, being a team player and collaborating with different stakeholders as part of an international team of wealth planning professionals

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a domestic and global team, both in person and in virtual formats

• Self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset

• Spanish native speaker. Fluent in English. Additional European language skills, including German are a distinct advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Cerchiamo un altamente qualificato Wealth Planner per aderire Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning con sede a Zurigo, Svizzera. Wealth Planning, un'unità di Global Products & Solutions (GPS), è un'offerta di base del Gruppo JB e fornisce una pianificazione di ricchezza specializzata per supportare Relationship Managers (RM) nell'acquisizione, mantenimento e mantenimento di relazioni con i clienti privati. La vostra responsabilità principale sarà quella di fornire una guida alla pianificazione della ricchezza e introdurre prodotti e soluzioni per la pianificazione della ricchezza per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti privati.

Il candidato di successo si distinguerà per la loro capacità di offrire l'eccellenza in due aree chiave. Il primo è come esperto di materia tematica nei mercati latinoamericani dove sarà necessaria l'agilità nei temi della pianificazione della ricchezza, tra cui filantropia, trasferimento, pianificazione della successione, tassazione e strutturazione della ricchezza. (Prova esperienza in Messico, ma non solo, sarà un vantaggio distinto.) Il secondo è in relazione al nostro cliente chiave e ultra-alto segmento di valore netto, che è più universale e meno specifico paese in natura. Qui, l'esperienza nei temi della governance familiare e l'armonizzazione di questi con le strutture di ricchezza necessarie distinguono il profilo ideale.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Fornire una guida strategica per la pianificazione della ricchezza ai RM e ai loro clienti, coordinando attivamente il processo di pianificazione della ricchezza sfruttando esperti interni ed esterni secondo necessità

• Implementare soluzioni adatte, come assicurazioni private, trust privati, fondazioni private o aziende private in collaborazione con fornitori interni ed esterni

• Servire come specialista di materia nell'interazione con il cliente, seguendo il processo JB Advisory, che comprende l'analisi, la discussione dei principi, la valutazione dei concetti, la proposta di soluzioni/servizi, l'implementazione e il follow-up

• Sostenere il team Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) nel fornire servizi alle prospettive e ai clienti di UHNW, applicando l’offerta del WP, con particolare attenzione alla Family Roadmap, allo scopo della famiglia (incluso Philanthropy Advisory) e al governo della famiglia, tra gli altri

• Resta aggiornato con i cambiamenti di settore, legali, regolamentari e fiscali, e informa i clienti e le parti interessate interne di conseguenza

• Supportare RM e altri stakeholder fornendo formazione, trasferimento di conoscenze e assistenza su temi e servizi/prodotti di pianificazione della ricchezza

Il tuo progetto
Qualifiche professionali & Istruzione

• Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza professionale nei settori dei servizi finanziari rilevanti o simili pratiche dei clienti privati (ad esempio banca privata, pratica legale, consulente fiscale, società fiduciaria)

• Laurea in Giurisprudenza (una qualifica di paese latinoamericano), master in imposta o un campo correlato è un must. Ulteriori qualifiche sulla governance familiare e l'esperienza nel servire i clienti privati sarebbero di vantaggio. Ulteriori corsi legati all'area di competenza, come l'accreditamento STEP, sono preferiti

Esperienza e competenze

• L'approccio client-centrico. Passione per la pianificazione della ricchezza consigli per privati HNW e UHNW individui

• Impegnare la personalità con la capacità di lavorare in modo efficace con i clienti ad alto valore di rete, garantendo le loro esigenze e obiettivi sono soddisfatti

• Il viaggio per vincere, mantenere e mantenere i clienti sarà richiesto su base ad hoc, tra cui in America Latina

• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli. Forte etica del lavoro, essere un giocatore di squadra e collaborare con diversi stakeholder come parte di un team internazionale di professionisti della pianificazione della ricchezza

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborare efficacemente all'interno di un team nazionale e globale, sia di persona che in formati virtuali

• Self-starter con una mentalità orientata alla soluzione

• Altoparlante nativo spagnolo. Fluente in inglese. Ulteriori competenze linguistiche europee, tra cui il tedesco sono un vantaggio distinto

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Wealth Planer für Julius Bär (JB) Wealth Planning mit Sitz in Zürich, Schweiz. Wealth Planning, eine Einheit von Global Products & Solutions (GPS), ist ein Kernangebot der JB Group und bietet spezialisierte Vermögensplanung zur Unterstützung von Relationship Managern (RMs) bei der Akquisition, Pflege und Pflege privater Kundenbeziehungen. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, eine Orientierung für die Vermögensplanung zu bieten und Produkte und Lösungen für die Vermögensplanung einzuführen, die den Bedürfnissen unserer Privatkunden entsprechen.

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird sich durch seine Fähigkeit auszeichnen, Exzellenz in zwei Schlüsselbereichen zu liefern. Die erste ist als Fachexperte in lateinamerikanischen Märkten, in denen Agilität in Vermögensplanungsthemen wie Philanthropie, Umsiedlung, Nachfolgeplanung, Besteuerung und Vermögensstrukturierung erforderlich sind. (Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Mexiko, aber nicht nur, wird ein deutlicher Vorteil sein.) Die zweite bezieht sich auf unser Hauptkunden- und Ultra-High-Net-Value-Segment, das universeller und weniger länderspezifisch ist. Hier wird durch Erfahrung in Family Governance-Themen und deren Harmonisierung mit den benötigten Vermögensstrukturen das ideale Profil unterschieden.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Strategische Wealth-Planing-Beratung für RMs und ihre Kunden, indem sie den Wealth-Planungsprozess aktiv koordinieren, indem sie bei Bedarf interne und externe Experten einsetzen

• Implementieren Sie geeignete Lösungen wie private Versicherungen, private Trusts, private Stiftungen oder private Unternehmen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Anbietern

• Als Fachspezialist für Kundeninteraktionen dienen, nach dem JB-Beratungsprozess, der Faktenfindung, Analyse, Diskussion von Prinzipien, Bewertung von Konzepten, Vorschlag von Lösungen / Dienstleistungen, Implementierung und Follow-up umfasst

• Unterstützen Sie das Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team bei der Bereitstellung von Dienstleistungen für UHNW-Perspektiven und -Kunden, indem Sie das Angebot von WP anwenden, unter anderem mit Schwerpunkt auf Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (einschließlich Philanthropy Advisory) und Family Governance.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Branchen-, Rechts-, Regulierungs- und Steueränderungen und informieren Sie Kunden und interne Stakeholder entsprechend

• Unterstützung von RMs und anderen Stakeholdern durch Schulungen, Wissenstransfer und Unterstützung zu Themen der Vermögensplanung und Dienstleistungen/Produkten

IHR PROFIL
Berufsqualifikationen & Ausbildung

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in relevanten Finanzdienstleistungssektoren oder vergleichbaren Privatkundenpraktiken (z. B. Privatbank, Rechtspraxis, Steuerberater, Treuhandgesellschaft)

• Universitätsabschluss in Rechtswissenschaften (eine lateinamerikanische Länderqualifikation), Master in Steuer oder einem verwandten Bereich ist ein Muss. Zusätzliche Qualifikationen in Bezug auf Family Governance und Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Privatkunden wären von Vorteil. Zusätzliche Kurse, die mit dem Fachgebiet verbunden sind, wie die STEP-Akkreditierung, werden bevorzugt

Erfahrung & Kompetenzen

• Kundenzentrierter Ansatz. Leidenschaft für Wealth Planning Beratung für private HNW und UHNW Einzelpersonen

• Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit vermögenden Kunden zu arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Bedürfnisse und Ziele erfüllt werden

• Reisen, um Kunden zu gewinnen, zu pflegen und zu behalten, sind auf Ad-hoc-Basis erforderlich, auch nach Lateinamerika

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail. Starke Arbeitsmoral, Teamplayer zu sein und mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern als Teil eines internationalen Teams von Vermögensplanungsexperten zusammenzuarbeiten

• Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und effektiv in einem nationalen und globalen Team zu arbeiten, sowohl persönlich als auch in virtuellen Formaten

• Selbststarter mit lösungsorientiertem Mindset

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Nous recherchons un planificateur de patrimoine hautement qualifié pour rejoindre Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning basé à Zurich, Suisse. Wealth Planning, une unité de Global Products & Solutions (GPS), est une offre de base du Groupe JB et fournit une planification de patrimoine spécialisée pour soutenir les gestionnaires de relations (RM) dans l'acquisition, le maintien et le maintien de relations client privées. Votre responsabilité principale sera de fournir des conseils en planification de patrimoine et d'introduire des produits et des solutions de planification de patrimoine pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients privés.

La candidate reçue se démarquera pour sa capacité à atteindre l'excellence dans deux domaines clés. Le premier est en tant qu'expert sur les marchés latino-américains où l'agilité dans les sujets de planification de la richesse, y compris la philanthropie, la délocalisation, la planification de la succession, la fiscalité et la structuration de la richesse, sera nécessaire. (L'expérience éprouvée au Mexique, mais pas seulement, sera un avantage distinct.) La deuxième concerne notre principal client et notre segment de valeur nette ultra-haute, qui est plus universel et de nature moins spécifique au pays. Ici, l'expérience en matière de gouvernance familiale et l'harmonisation avec les structures de richesse nécessaires distingueront le profil idéal.

Votre défi

• Fournir des conseils stratégiques en matière de planification de la richesse aux GR et à leurs clients, en coordonnant activement le processus de planification de la richesse en faisant appel à des experts internes et externes au besoin.

• Mettre en œuvre des solutions appropriées, telles que les assurances privées, les fiducies privées, les fondations privées ou les entreprises privées en collaboration avec des fournisseurs internes et externes

• Servir de spécialiste des interactions avec les clients, à la suite du processus consultatif du BJ, qui comprend l'établissement des faits, l'analyse, la discussion des principes, l'évaluation des concepts, la proposition de solutions/services, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi

• Soutenir l'équipe de planification de patrimoine des clients clés et des services de bureau à la famille (SFO) dans la prestation de services aux perspectives et aux clients de l'UHNW, en appliquant l'offre du WP, en mettant l'accent sur la feuille de route familiale, l'objectif familial (y compris l'avis de philanthropie) et la gouvernance familiale, entre autres

• Restez à jour avec l'industrie, les changements juridiques, réglementaires et fiscaux et informez les clients et les intervenants internes en conséquence

• Soutenir les RM et les autres parties prenantes en offrant formation, transfert de connaissances et assistance sur des sujets et des services/produits de planification du patrimoine

VOTRE PROFIL
Qualifications professionnelles et formation

• Minimum de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les secteurs pertinents des services financiers ou des pratiques comparables des clients privés (p. ex. banque privée, pratique juridique, conseiller fiscal, société fiduciaire)

• Diplôme universitaire en droit (un diplôme de pays d'Amérique latine), maîtrise en fiscalité ou un domaine connexe est un must. Des qualifications supplémentaires sur la gouvernance familiale et l'expérience du service à la clientèle privée seraient avantageuses. D'autres cours liés au domaine d'expertise, comme l'accréditation STEP, sont préférés.

Expérience et compétences

• Approche axée sur le client. Passion pour les conseils de planification de patrimoine pour les particuliers HNW et UHNW

• Mobiliser la personnalité avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec des clients de grande valeur, en veillant à ce que leurs besoins et objectifs soient atteints

• Les voyages pour gagner, maintenir et retenir les clients seront nécessaires au cas par cas, y compris en Amérique latine.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et attention aux détails. Forte éthique du travail, être un acteur d'équipe et collaborer avec différentes parties prenantes dans le cadre d'une équipe internationale de professionnels de la planification de patrimoine

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe nationale et mondiale, tant en personne qu'en format virtuel

• Auto-démarrage avec un état d'esprit orienté solution

• Locuteur natif espagnol. En anglais. D'autres compétences linguistiques européennes, dont l'allemand, constituent un avantage distinct.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As an experienced banking accountant, you will play a key role within Financial Accounting, covering accounting activities for Lending, Banking Operations (including Client Corporate Actions), and Cash Desk. Acting as a trusted subject-matter expert, you will manage daily accounting tasks and actively drive the continuous improvement of accounting processes and systems.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Advice, development and monitoring of sub-ledgers within the relevant business areas

• Actively participate in projects aimed at optimising and automating accounting processes, including the definition of booking logics and data flows

• Collaborate in the preparation and analysis of financial statements and reports in accordance with IFRS and Swiss Banking GAAP (RVI)

• Provide expert support related to internal and external audits, and for reconciliations between finance systems and core banking platforms

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across departments such as Group Tax, Management Accounting, IT Operations, and Payroll

• Participate in the testing, implementation, and rollout of new functionalities in SAP and core banking systems

• Support in ensuring data quality and further developing  internal controls. Analysis, specification, and optimisation of existing processes

• Provide training to employees and prepare user documentation (primarily in English)

• Support the individual locations worldwide from a financial accounting perspective

• Ensuring consistent adherence to internal control systems

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed financial or business administration education with further training in accounting (e.g. specialist certificate in finance and accounting, Bachelor/Master in Accounting or Banking & Finance)

• Several years of professional experience in bank accounting, preferably in the areas of lending, banking operations or corporate actions

• Experience with T24 or comparable core banking systems mandatory

• Sound knowledge of banking products, particularly in lending

• Good understanding of IFRS and Swiss Banking GAAP (RVI) is an advantage

• Project experience with SAP and use of SAP is an advantage

• Sound handling of MS Office programmes

• Very good English language skills, both written and spoken. Fluency in German is an advantage

• Strong analytical skills as well as independent and meticulous  work approach

• Team-oriented personality with strong communication skills and resilience

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You are a member of the System Architects team within global IT Architecture. Together with your colleagues from the Domain and Foundation Architecture teams, you are responsible for designing Solution Architectures.

As a System Architect, you build bridges to Software Engineering and ensure that software solutions follow the target architecture.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You design and are responsible for the solution architecture for applications in delivery

• You ensure that your solution architectures in delivery adhere to architecture standards and are aligned with the target architectures of the domain

• You raise and manage architecture debt when there is a misalignment between transition and the target architectures

• You initiate architecture decisions, document them as Architecture Decision Records (ADR) and have them approved by the relevant architecture boards

• You advise and coach software engineers on the implementation of solution architectures and ensure technical feasibility

• In addition to architecture design, you also support later phases of the software lifecycle, such as testing, release and operations

YOUR PROFILE

• 3+ years of experience as a senior architect, 5+ years of experience as a lead or senior software engineer

• Responsible for solution architectures: from design and implementation to operation

• Ability to identify options for solution architectures and make trade-off architecture decisions

• Experience with SAP solutions, especially S4/HANA, BW/HANA, BTP

• Good understanding of Financial Accounting, Management Accounting

• Knowledge of IFRS and Swiss GAAP in financial service industries

• Analysing complex business requirements and translating them into technical solutions

• Ability to abstract complex topics and focus on the key issues that need architecture decisions

• Collaboratively develop and coordinate solutions with business and technology stakeholders and architecture colleagues

• Proactive mindset, able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

• Proven experience in solution design and knowledge of current architecture styles, such as event-driven, microservices, modular monolith

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Fluency in English (verbal/written), German is beneficial

Sei un membro del team System Architects all'interno di Global IT Architecture. Insieme ai vostri colleghi dei team Domain and Foundation Architecture, siete responsabili della progettazione di Solution Architectures.

Come System Architect, si costruisce ponti per Software Engineering e assicurarsi che le soluzioni software seguono l'architettura di destinazione.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Lei progetta e è responsabile per l'architettura della soluzione per le applicazioni nella consegna

• Assicurarsi che le architetture di soluzione in consegna aderiscano agli standard di architettura e sono allineati con le architetture di destinazione del dominio

• Alzi e gestisci il debito di architettura quando c'è un disallineamento tra la transizione e le architetture di destinazione

• Iniziate le decisioni di architettura, documentatele come l'Architettura Decision Records (ADR) e li avete approvati dai relativi pannelli di architettura

• Si consiglia e allenatore ingegneri software per l'implementazione di architetture di soluzione e garantire la fattibilità tecnica

• Oltre al design dell'architettura, supporta anche fasi successive del ciclo di vita del software, come test, rilascio e operazioni

Il tuo progetto

• 3+ anni di esperienza come architetto senior, 5+ anni di esperienza come lead o ingegnere software senior

• Responsabile per le architetture di soluzione: dalla progettazione e realizzazione al funzionamento

• Capacità di identificare le opzioni per le architetture di soluzione e prendere decisioni di architettura di trade-off

• Esperienza con soluzioni SAP, in particolare S4/HANA, BW/HANA, BTP

• Buona comprensione della contabilità finanziaria, gestione contabile

• Conoscenza degli IFRS e del GAAP svizzero nelle industrie dei servizi finanziari

• Analizzando i complessi requisiti aziendali e traducendoli in soluzioni tecniche

• Capacità di astratto argomenti complessi e concentrarsi sui temi chiave che hanno bisogno di decisioni di architettura

• Sviluppare e coordinare collaborativamente soluzioni con gli stakeholder aziendali e tecnologici e i colleghi di architettura

• Mindset attivo, in grado di lavorare sotto pressione e rispettare le scadenze

• Esperienza comprovata nella progettazione e nella conoscenza di stili di architettura attuali, come ad esempio i microservizi, i monolite modulari

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

• Fluenza in inglese (verbale/scritto), tedesco è benefico

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Senior Technical Product Owner, you will own and continuously evolve Workday Recruiting and External Workforce Management capabilities, with a particular focus on Workday Recruiting and Workday VNDLY. Acting as the technical lead for these platforms, you will drive solution design, integrations, and continuous improvement while partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable and sustainable Workday solutions.

• Drive the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday solutions supporting permanent and external workforce processes

• Act as the primary technical subject matter expert for Workday Recruiting and VNDLY

• Evaluate new Workday capabilities and innovations and translate them into business value

• Support strategic workforce initiatives, including external workforce and contingent labour management programs

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field

• Extensive experience as a Technical Product Owner, Workday Product Owner, Solution Architect, or in a similar role within complex enterprise environments

• Strong expertise in Workday, with proven experience in Workday Recruiting and ideally Workday VNDLY

• Solid understanding of Workday architecture, configuration, security, business processes, and integrations

• Experience managing and evolving Workday products and capabilities in a global organization

• Strong knowledge of system integrations, APIs, and enterprise application landscapes

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions

• Proven track record of working effectively with both business and technology stakeholders

• Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills combined with a pragmatic delivery mindset

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• High level of ownership, accountability, and customer focus

• Workday certifications and experience in contingent workforce management are considered strong assets

• Proficient in English
